Hvem er viNordjysk Lift er en del af Renta Group - en af Nordens førende udlejningsvirksomheder inden for maskiner og materiel. Det betyder, at du får det bedste fra to verdener: en lokal afdeling med kort vej fra idé til handling og en stærk koncern i ryggen med stor faglighed, erfaring og gode udviklingsmuligheder.

Om jobbetSom udlejningskonsulent i Thisted bliver du en del af en afdeling med 4 medarbejdere, hvor vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af opgaverne - uanset om det gælder en kunde, klargøring af en maskine eller noget helt tredje. Du bliver ansvarlig for udlejning af materiel til erhvervskunder, og dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Personligt og telefonisk salg og rådgivning til kunder

  • Udarbejdelse af tilbud, lejekontrakter og andre administrative opgaver

  • Udlevering af maskiner og værktøj samt håndtering af indleveret materiel

  • Klargøring af maskiner og praktiske opgaver i afdelingen

Stillingen er på fuld tid, 41,5 timer om ugen.

Om digDu har erfaring med udlejning, kundeservice og kundekontakt og har flair for at skabe og vedligeholde gode kunderelationer. Det er en fordel, hvis du har maskinkendskab eller er god til at bruge dine hænder, men det er ikke et krav. Det er en forudsætning, at du har kørekort, og det er en fordel, hvis du har truckcertifikat.

Som person er du imødekommende og løsningsorienteret, og du trives i et travlt miljø med skiftende opgaver. Da vi er en lille afdeling, lægger vi stor vægt på, at du er en positiv og hjælpsom kollega, som giver en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et spændende job og en varieret hverdag

  • Et lille, tæt team med en uformel og humoristisk tone

  • Gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling som en del af Renta Group

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn efter kvalifikationer

Interesseret?Kan du se dig selv som en del af holdet i Thisted? Ansøg hurtigst muligt via formularen eller send en mail til job@nordjysklift.dk med "Udlejningskonsulent Thisted" i emnefeltet.

Vi ønsker opstart hurtigst muligt og holder samtaler løbende. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jesper Pedersen på telefon 30 85 85 55.

title: Koordinerende klubmedarbejder
description:
SPOT 8380 søger to klubmedarbejdere/koordinatorer

Brænder du for at gøre en forskel for unge, og er du god til at skabe relationer, tage initiativ og få idéer til at blive til virkelighed? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Hvem er vi?

SPOT 8380 er en mindre, men ambitiøs ungdomsklub i Trige for unge mellem 13 og 18 år. Vi har åbent torsdag og søndag kl. 19–22 og arbejder seriøst med at skabe et frirum med fællesskaber, aktiviteter og plads til at være ung.

Vi har store ambitioner om at udvikle klubben, styrke samarbejdet med lokale aktører og få endnu flere unge til at blive en del af fællesskabet.

Vi søger to forskellige profiler

Vi har to ledige stillinger og søger medarbejdere, der med forskellige kompetencer kan bidrage til klubbens drift og udvikling.

Den koordinerende profil

Du arbejder bag kulisserne, aflaster personalegruppen, etablerer lokale samarbejder og sikrer, at vores idéer og initiativer bliver ført ud i livet.

Den kombinerede klubmedarbejder- og koordinatorprofil

Du bidrager både til de koordinerende opgaver og arbejder direkte med de unge i klubbens åbningstid. Her er du med til at skabe gode relationer, spændende aktiviteter og trygge fællesskaber.

Den konkrete sammensætning af opgaver og timer afhænger af din profil, dine kompetencer og interesser.

Dine arbejdsopgaver kan blandt andet være

  • Etablere og udvikle samarbejder med professionelle og frivillige hos lokale foreninger, institutioner og andre aktører.

  • Undersøge nye samarbejdsmuligheder, der kan få flere unge til at bruge klubben.

  • Bistå med planlægning og koordinering af større aktiviteter i samarbejde med personalet.

  • Aflaste personalegruppen med praktiske og koordinerende opgaver.

  • Følge op på aftaler og sikre, at idéer og beslutninger bliver omsat til handling.

  • Bidrage med egne idéer til udviklingen af klubben.

  • Arbejde direkte med de unge i klubbens åbningstid, afhængigt af din profil.

Opgaverne defineres og prioriteres i samarbejde med personalegruppen, men der er også plads til egne idéer og selvstændige initiativer.

Hvem er du?

Først og fremmest brænder du for at gøre en forskel for unge og har lyst til at bidrage til stærke lokale fællesskaber.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er selvstændig, opsøgende og god til at skabe relationer.

  • Har overblik og er god til at koordinere.

  • Tager ansvar og følger opgaver helt til dørs.

  • Er idérig og ser muligheder i samarbejdet med andre.

Det er en stor fordel, hvis du bor i Trige eller har et godt kendskab til lokalområdet. Erfaring med boligsociale indsatser, sociale tilbud, ungdomsarbejde eller foreningssamarbejde er ligeledes en fordel.

Du behøver ikke have en bestemt uddannelse. Det vigtigste er dit engagement, dine samarbejdsevner og din evne til at få ting til at ske.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du bliver en del af en engageret personalegruppe i en klub med højt til loftet og store ambitioner på de unges vegne.

Du får en fleksibel og varieret hverdag med mulighed for at præge klubbens udvikling og gøre en konkret forskel for unge i lokalområdet.

Praktisk information

  • Antal ledige stillinger: 2.

  • Arbejdstid: 5–10 timer om ugen afhængigt af din profil.

  • Ansættelse: Tidsbegrænset til ét år.

  • Fleksjob: Vi er også åbne over for ansøgninger fra fleksjobbere med en arbejdstid på maksimalt 6 timer om ugen.

  • Fleksibilitet: Du tilrettelægger i høj grad selv dine koordineringsopgaver. Møder med samarbejdspartnere ligger typisk i dagtimerne eller om eftermiddagen.

  • Klubvagter: Torsdag og søndag kl. 19–22, afhængigt af din profil.

  • Personalemøder: Cirka én gang om måneden, typisk fra kl. 17.

  • Organisering: Du refererer formelt til SPOT 8380's bestyrelse, men indgår i det daglige i tæt samarbejde med den øvrige personalegruppe.

  • Arbejdssted: Smedebroen 21B, 8380 Trige.

Vil du være med?

Vi leder efter mennesker, der deler vores ambitioner for de unge og kan hjælpe os med at få tingene til at ske.

Mere handling, mindre snak og endnu flere unge i klubben!

Send din ansøgning til spotungdomsklub@gmail.com med ansøgning og CV senest den 4. december 2026.

Fortæl gerne i din ansøgning, hvilken af de to profiler du bedst kan se dig selv i.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Anders Mondrup på telefon 93 98 19 06.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

SPOT 8380

title: DGI Nordsjælland søger en foreningskonsulent til svømning
description:
Vil du være en del af en organisation, som går forrest i udviklingen af idrætsforeningerne? Har du en faglighed inden for svømning og et stærkt foreningskendskab? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i DGI Nordsjælland. 

Svømning bliver dit primære fagområde, men vi forventer også, at du er nysgerrig på, hvordan vi kan udvikle nye aktiviteter og fællesskaber i, på og omkring vand. Det kan fx være vinterbadning og andre nye vandaktiviteter. Du skal kunne spotte muligheder og tendenser og omsætte dem til aktiviteter og samarbejder med idrætsforeninger, frivillige og andre relevante aktører. 

Med udgangspunkt i din faglige viden og erfaring skal du samarbejde med foreninger, sikre udvikling af aktiviteter samt udbyde kurser/uddannelse for trænere og ledere. Du understøtter foreningerne i deres dagligdag og er deres sparringspartner.  

Udover et tæt makkerskab med den administrative koordinator vil du indgå i teams med kolleger, som dækker andre idrætter og projekter på tværs af huset. Generelt søger vi at skabe et godt arbejdsfællesskab med masser af mulighed for sparring og samarbejde. 

Ansvarsområder:  

  • Være svømmeforeningers foretrukne go-to person og samarbejdspartnere og sikre jævnlig kontakt.  
  • Etablere stærke relationer og netværk til foreningslivet i Nordsjælland.  
  • Sikre løbende opfølgning på svømmeklubbernes behov og formidle relevante tilbud til klubberne.
  • Drive resultatorienterede og involverende udviklingsprocesser med svømmeklubberne i centrum.  
  • Planlægge aktiviteter og indsatser med afsæt i DGI's formål, mål og værdier. 
  • Opsøge nye tendenser og muligheder inden for fx vinterbadning, saunagus og andre vandaktiviteter og omsætte dem til relevante initiativer i samarbejde med foreninger og andre aktører. 
  • Skabe og understøtte nye samarbejder mellem foreninger og andre lokale aktører om fælles dagsordener og udvikling i lokalsamfundet. 
  • Bidrage proaktivt til koordination, samarbejde og udvikling i afdelingen og på tværs af huset. 
  • Være ansvarlig for budget og regnskabsopfølgning.

Vi har følgende ønskeliste til din profil: 

  • Stor idrætsfaglig viden. Det er en fordel hvis du har særlig indsigt i svømning/aktiviteter i vand.  
  • Er nysgerrig, initiativrig og har blik for nye tendenser og muligheder inden for idræt, bevægelse og fællesskaber. 
  • Kendskab til foreningslivet og DGI gennem frivilligt virke og/eller ansættelse i en forening.  
  • Kompetencer indenfor udvikling, problemløsning, procesfacilitering og behovsanalyse.  
  • Stærke relations-, samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner.  
  • Evner at arbejde selvstændigt og i teams.  
  • Evner at arbejde i løbende forandringer.  
  • Trives godt med målorienteret og struktureret arbejde.  

 Er du den erfarne konsulent der kan skabe resultater så læs mere om DGI Svømning. 

Vi tilbyder dig: 

  • En mulighed for at arbejde med svømning, vinterbadning og øvrige vandaktiviteter i DGI Nordsjælland. 
  • Et skrivebord i et kollegialt og fagligt kontormiljø med frokost som en del af arbejdstiden. 
  • Mulighed for hjemmearbejde når opgaven eller privatlivet kræver det.  
  • En alsidig hverdag der både består af kontorarbejde og fyraftensmøder hos foreningerne.   
  • Fuld flextid og 1-1 afspadsering – arbejder du lang tid den ene dag, skal du have noget mere frihed en anden dag.  
  • Maksimal frihed under ansvar og stor mulighed for indflydelse på dine arbejdsopgaver.  
  • Gode muligheder for at vokse i jobbet via efteruddannelse og kompetent sparring.  

Praktiske forhold:  Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse 1. februar 2027. Der skal forventes aften- og weekendarbejde i stillingen.  Vi forventer 1. runde samtaler mandag den 14. december 2026 samt evt. 2. runde samtale den 17. december 2026.

description:

title: Bliv vores nye serviceleder – sammen skaber vi tryghed og kvalitet
description:
Har du lyst til at være den leder, der både har blik for mennesker, kvalitet og den gode kundeoplevelse?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Som serviceleder hos Coor får du en vigtig rolle i hverdagen på vores forskellige lokationer i København. Du bliver den, der får tingene til at hænge sammen, og som samtidig er tæt på både medarbejdere og kunder.

Det er et job med ansvar, variation og masser af menneskelig kontakt. Vi tror nemlig på, at god service starter med, at vores medarbejdere trives og føler sig set.

Din hverdag hos os

Som serviceleder får du ansvar for ca. 40 medarbejdere, og du bliver en vigtig sparringspartner for dem i deres hverdag.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • følge op på, at arbejdet udføres i den aftalte kvalitet og efter arbejdsplanerne

  • sikre, at den planlagte arbejdstid overholdes

  • træne og udvikle dine medarbejdere

  • sørge for den daglige arbejdsfordeling ved sygdom og andet fravær

  • være med til at rekruttere, ansætte og afskedige servicemedarbejdere

  • stå for ferieplanlægning, time- og lønregistrering samt andre administrative opgaver

  • have løbende dialog med vores kunder og være med til at skabe stærke og tillidsfulde relationer

Du får en hverdag, hvor ikke to dage nødvendigvis er ens. Derfor skal du trives med at tage ansvar, finde løsninger og bevare overblikket, også når planer pludselig ændrer sig.

Et job med kørsel og frihed.

Arbejdssted: KøbenhavnArbejdstid: Fuldtid

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab

Hos os kommer du ikke til at stå alene.

Du bliver en del af en afdeling med dygtige og fagligt stærke kolleger, hvor vi har en uformel tone og lægger vægt på, at vi hjælper hinanden.

Som leder bliver du tæt på dine medarbejdere, og vi forventer, at du er en leder, der ser mennesket bag medarbejderen.

For os handler god ledelse ikke kun om planer, kvalitet og drift. Det handler også om at være tilgængelig, lytte, følge op og skabe en hverdag, hvor medarbejderne ved, hvad der forventes af dem - og hvor de føler sig værdsat.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med ledelse og gerne fra rengøringsbranchen. Du behøver ikke kunne alt fra første dag – det vigtigste er, at du har lysten, engagementet og evnen til at få mennesker med dig.

Vi lægger blandt andet vægt på, at du:

  • har erfaring inden for rengøringsfaget

  • har ledelseserfaring eller lyst og mod på at tage næste skridt som leder

  • er god til mennesker og naturligt skaber tillid og relationer

  • har et højt servicegen og sætter en ære i at levere kvalitet

  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • kan bevare overblikket, når hverdagen bliver travl

  • har gode IT-kompetencer og kan sætte dig ind i nye systemer

  • har erfaring med MS Office

  • er omstillingsparat og trives i en driftsorienteret hverdag

  • har kørekort til kategori B

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du kan opnå den nødvendige sikkerhedsgodkendelse. Som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen skal du derfor være indstillet på at gennemgå den relevante sikkerhedsprocedure. Derudover skal vi kunne indhente din straffeattest og, hvor det er relevant, børneattest.

Du behøver ikke kunne sætte flueben ved det hele

Hvis du læser opslaget og tænker: “Det her lyder spændende, men jeg kan ikke helt sætte flueben ved det hele” så vil vi stadig gerne høre fra dig.

For nogle gange er det ikke den kandidat, der matcher hvert eneste punkt på papiret, der viser sig at være det helt rigtige match.

Måske har du den erfaring, personlighed og tilgang til mennesker, som vi leder efter. Det vil vi gerne lære dig at kende for.

Har du lyst til at blive en del af Coor?

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og tager opslaget ned, når vi har fundet vores nye kollega.

Vi opfordrer dig til at undlade billede på dit CV eller din ansøgning, da vi ønsker en så upartisk rekrutteringsproces som muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig måske er det netop dig, vi mangler på holdet.

title: Kantineassistent til vores hovedkontor - skab gode frokostoplevelser på 37 timer om ugen
description:
Kokkenes Køkken · Vores hovedkontor · Kantineassistent · 37 timer om ugen

En god frokost giver kollegerne et velsmagende måltid og et pusterum i arbejdsdagen. Vi søger en kantineassistent til vores hovedkontor, der har lyst til at bidrage til både maden, servicen og de praktiske opgaver, som får kantinen til at fungere.

Din hverdag

Du får en hverdag med forskellige opgaver omkring klargøring, frokostservering og oprydning. Du bidrager til, at kantinen er indbydende, og at vores kolleger bliver mødt med venlighed og god service.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Klargøring og tilberedning. Du hjælper med at skylle og snitte grøntsager, klargøre råvarer og tilberede enkle retter efter køkkenets anvisninger.

  • Anretning og opfyldning. Du hjælper med at gøre frokosten klar, anrette maden og fylde op under serveringen, så den fremstår frisk og indbydende.

  • Service i kantinen. Du møder vores kolleger venligt og hjælper med praktiske spørgsmål omkring dagens frokost.

  • Opvask og oprydning. Du vasker service og køkkenudstyr op og sørger for, at det kommer på plads og er klar til brug.

  • Rengøring og hygiejne. Du rengør de aftalte arbejdsområder og følger køkkenets anvisninger for fødevarehygiejne og håndtering af råvarer.

I en kantine skal flere opgaver være færdige på samme tid. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan holde overblik, samarbejde og tilpasse dig dagens opgaver uden at gå på kompromis med kvalitet og hygiejne.

Det får du hos os

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

  • En arbejdsplads på vores hovedkontor, hvor du bidrager direkte til kollegernes hverdag.

  • En rolle med både praktiske køkkenopgaver og kontakt med kantinens gæster.

Det kommer du med

  • Du arbejder omhyggeligt og har forståelse for god køkkenhygiejne.

  • Du tager ansvar for dine opgaver og samarbejder om at få dagens arbejde til at lykkes.

  • Du møder stabilt og møder kolleger og gæster med venlighed og respekt.

Erfaring fra kantine, køkken eller lignende servicearbejde er en fordel. Du har lyst til at arbejde med mad og mennesker og giver en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det.

Løn og vilkår

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger Kantineoverenskomsten.

Om os

Kokkenes Køkken er en del af Forenede Service. Vi driver kantiner med fokus på smag, madhåndværk og gæsternes måltidsoplevelse.

Vores værdier udgør fundamentet for vores kultur og er: Ansvar - Engagement - Omtanke

Det betyder, at vi tager ansvar for at levere velsmagende mad, god service og ordentlig hygiejne, så vores gæster får en god måltidsoplevelse. Vi viser engagement ved at have et professionelt udtryk, fremstå ordentligt og præsentabelt og bruge de metoder, vi bliver oplært i. Vi bruger omtanke ved at vise hensyn og respekt for vores gæster og kolleger og ved at passe på de råvarer, det udstyr og de omgivelser, vi arbejder med hver dag.

Sådan søger du

Du søger ved at klikke på knappen Ansøg og uploade dit CV og din ansøgning.

Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Teknisk servicemedarbejder søges til Bygningsdrift
description:
Bygningsdrift søger en fleksibel og serviceminded medarbejder til en fuldtidsstilling. Vi leder efter dig, der har en håndværksmæssig baggrund og/eller en uddannelse som ejendomsservicetekniker – gerne med flere års erfaring fra en lignende stilling.

Om Bygningsdrift

Bygningsdrift er en del af Drift og Service, hvor vi står for drift og vedligeholdelse af kommunens ejendomme, herunder kulturinstitutioner og daginstitutioner og skoler. Arbejdsstedet varierer afhængigt af opgaver og behov. Som led i Herlev Kommunes grønne omstilling foregår transporten mellem institutionerne og skoler på el-cykel.

Teamet består af 6 medarbejdere og en serviceleder, som varetager den daglige drift.

Om dig

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • har godt humør, mødestabilitet og en god portion humor.
  • har et alsidigt, praktisk håndelag og er løsningsorienteret.
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også trives i et team.
  • er serviceminded og trives i en hverdag med mange børn omkring sig.
  • kan bevare overblikket og strukturere mange opgaver og beskeder.
  • har kørekort til bil (kategori B).
  • har kendskab til Office-pakken på brugerniveau og flair for IT-værktøjer.
  • taler og skriver dansk.
Opgaverne

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • tilsyn og vedligeholdelse af bygninger, klimaskærme m.m.
  • tilsyn og vedligeholdelse af tekniske installationer.
  • udføre håndværksmæssige reparationer.
  • akutte driftsopgaver.
  • opstilling af borde og stole til arrangementer.
  • brandgennemgange, DKV-planer og brandeftersyn.
Løn og ansættelse

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til kvalifikationer og gældende overenskomst mellem kommunen og den relevante faglige organisation. I forbindelse med ansættelsen indhenter vi børne- og straffeattest samt referencer. Ansættelse ønskes pr. 1. januar 2027 eller hurtigst muligt derefter.

Herlev Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.

Ansøgning

Ansøgningsfristen er fredag den 18. december 2026. Vi afholder løbende samtaler.

Spørgsmål?

Læs mere om os på www.herlev.dk 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte funktionschef for Drift og Service, Frank Nør på 2925 5013.

Mød vores medarbejdere

På herlev.dk kan du møde nogle af vores medarbejdere fra forskellige arbejdspladser i kommunen. De fortæller hver især om, hvad de arbejder med, og hvorfor de er glade for deres arbejde.

Søg stillingen

Du søger stillingen online. Husk at vedhæfte din ansøgning, CV og andre relevante bilag. Når du har sendt ansøgningen, modtager du en e-mail som kvittering. Vær opmærksom på, at mailen kan være placeret i din mappe ”Spam/uønsket post”.

Om Herlev

Herlev er placeret i hjertet af hovedstadsområdet med en velfungerende infrastruktur. Transportmulighederne til og fra Herlev er gode med s-togsstation, busser og fire letbanestationer i byen. Samtidig byder Herlev på let adgang til grønne områder. Vi er i fuld gang med at udvikle byen, så den også i fremtiden har et levende handelsliv, en spændende bymidte og er attraktiv at bo og drive virksomhed i.

I Herlev Kommune arbejder vi ambitiøst og målrettet på at sikre, at vores tilbud til borgerne også i fremtiden er på et højt niveau. Det gør vi ved at indrette organisationen med et større fokus på at styrke fagligheden og understøtte dialogen med borgerne, samt forkorte afstanden mellem det lokale politiske niveau og kommunens medarbejdere.

title: Souschef for restaurant in Copenhagen
description:
We're looking for a Sous Chef at Levantin. You'll be the Head Chef's right hand, and you'll make sure the kitchen runs smoothly, every plate goes out right and the team keeps growing.

You'll spend most of your time on the line. You'll also assist plan schedules, stock levels and budgets.

What you'll do

  • Service. Lead service and make sure recipes are followed exactly, so every dish leaves the kitchen with the right portions and presentation. Set up stations for an efficient service.

  • Train the team. Run test shifts and onboard new cooks, train current staff for new stations.

  • Hygiene and food safety. Assist in making sure the kitchen follows self-inspection and food safety rules.

  • Order and count. Assist in placing daily and weekly orders, forecast prep, weekly and monthly counts.

  • Assist in planing the schedule. Assist in making the roster for the kitchen team within the wage budget, cover sickness and absence, and adjust staffing for large reservations.

  • Keep costs in check. Help the kitchen hit its budget targets and look for ways to reduce food cost and waste.

  • Put changes into practice. When menus or procedures change, get the team up to the new standard.

Who you are

  • You have experience as a Sous Chef, or as a Chef de Partie who's ready for the next step

  • You keep calm and organised during a busy service

  • You know food safety and hygiene rules well

  • You like teaching others and lead by example

  • You're precise with recipes and standards

  • You're comfortable with ordering, counts and scheduling, or you're keen to learn

What we offer

  • A key role in a growing restaurant group with several concepts

  • Close cooperation with the Head Chef and District Manager

  • Room to develop toward Head Chef and to influence the menu

title: SERVICE MANAGER WANTED AT SRS AF 2025 ApS
description:
SERVICE MANAGER WANTED AT SRS AF 2025 ApS

We are looking for a reliable and responsible Service Manager who would like to play an active role in our daily operations.

This is a hands-on position where you will have your own regular cleaning assignments while also helping to ensure that daily cleaning services run smoothly at our customers' premises.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Daily planning and coordination of tasks

  • Carrying out regular quality checks of cleaning services

  • Following up to ensure that tasks are completed as agreed

  • Performing cleaning duties at your own assigned locations

  • Covering cleaning duties during sickness and other staff absences

  • Providing practical assistance when urgent tasks arise during the day

  • Communicating with employees regarding daily operations

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is reliable, flexible and punctual

  • Can work independently and take responsibility

  • Has an eye for quality and attention to detail

  • Is willing to take part in cleaning duties

  • Can stay organised and adapt when daily plans change

  • Has good communication skills and enjoys working with different people

Experience in the cleaning industry or a similar service-related role is an advantage. However, what matters most to us is that you are responsible, solution-oriented and willing to take an active part in daily operations.

About the position

You will become an important part of the daily operations at SRS af 2025 ApS and enjoy a varied working day where no two days are necessarily the same.

It is important that you feel comfortable in a role where you have responsibility while also being actively involved in practical cleaning tasks at our customer sites.

Start date: As soon as possible.

If this position sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would be happy to receive a short application with some information about yourself and your previous experience.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Solution Architect (m/w/d) Customer Portals & E-Commerce (Software-Architect)
description: Du möchtest die Architektur hinter den digitalen Kundenlösungen der DLG gestalten und eine zentrale Rolle bei unserer digitalen Transformation übernehmen? Dann suchen wir genau dich! Als Solution Architect (m/w/d) verbindest du Business und Technologie und übernimmst die Verantwortung für die architektonische Ausrichtung unserer Kundenportale, B2B- und B2C-Commerce-Lösungen. Dich erwartet eine praxisorientierte Architekturrolle, in der du die Zielarchitektur definierst und gleichzeitig nah an der Entwicklung und Umsetzung bleibst. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit. Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt. AufgabenAls Solution Architect (m/w/d) verantwortest du die architektonische Ausrichtung deines Bereichs und gestaltest maßgeblich die Zukunft der digitalen Kundenlösungen der DLG.Du übersetzt Business-Anforderungen in durchdachte und zukunftsfähige Lösungskonzepte und stellst sicher, dass Architekturentscheidungen erfolgreich in Projekten und auf unseren Plattformen umgesetzt werden.Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören:- Du verantwortest die Zielarchitektur, Architekturprinzipien und Roadmap für unsere Kundenportale, B2B- und B2C-Commerce-Lösungen sowie die dazugehörigen digitalen Plattformen.- Du triffst zentrale Architekturentscheidungen und übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Auswahl und Ausrichtung von Plattformen, Technologien, Integrationen und Anbieterlösungen.- Du definierst Architekturvorgaben und stellst sicher, dass diese von unseren Entwicklungsteams und Implementierungspartnern konsequent angewendet werden.- Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklern und Projektteams zusammen, prüfst Lösungskonzepte, unterstützt bei technischen Entscheidungen und löst architektonische Herausforderungen.- Du steuerst die architektonische Ausrichtung externer Implementierungspartner und stellst sicher, dass die entwickelten Lösungen unseren Standards und langfristigen Unternehmenszielen entsprechen.ProfilDu bist ein erfahrener Solution Architect (m/w/d) oder Technical Lead (m/w/d) und hast Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und komplexe Business-Anforderungen in skalierbare, moderne Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du bewegst dich souverän zwischen Business und Technologie und fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem du sowohl die strategische Ausrichtung als auch die konkrete Umsetzung von Lösungen beeinflussen kannst.Um in dieser Position erfolgreich zu sein, bringst du Folgendes mit:- Du hast Erfahrung in der Konzeption von Lösungsarchitekturen für digitale Kundenprodukte, E-Commerce-Plattformen, Portale oder vergleichbare Anwendungen.- Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse moderner Anwendungsarchitekturen, Integrationen, APIs und Cloud-Native-Technologien.- Du hast Erfahrung mit Headless-, Composable- und API-First-Architekturen.- Du kannst Plattformen, SaaS-Lösungen und Anbieter bewerten und unterschiedliche Architekturansätze sowie deren Vor- und Nachteile fundiert beurteilen.- Du hast Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungsteams und externen Implementierungspartnern.- Du kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch. Deutsch- und/oder Dänischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.Unser AngebotBei DLG wirst du Teil einer Entwicklungsorganisation, die im Zuge unserer digitalen Transformation aktuell weiter gestärkt und ausgebaut wird. Dadurch hast du von Anfang an die Möglichkeit, unsere Architektur, die Zusammenarbeit und unsere technischen Standards aktiv mitzugestalten.Du kannst wichtige Technologieentscheidungen beeinflussen, die Architektur geschäftskritischer digitaler Lösungen prägen und eng mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus den Bereichen Business und Technologie zusammenarbeiten.Dich erwartet eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum. Du bestimmst die zukünftige Ausrichtung unserer digitalen Kundenlösungen maßgeblich mit und bleibst gleichzeitig eng in die Entwicklung und Umsetzung eingebunden.Weitere InformationenDein Arbeitsplatz kann wahlweise in Fredericia (Dänemark) oder Flensburg (Deutschland) sein.Du wirst Teil eines standortübergreifenden Teams und arbeitest eng mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen auf beiden Seiten der Grenze zusammen. Mobiles Arbeiten ist im Rahmen unserer Unternehmensrichtlinien möglich. Gleichzeitig legen wir Wert auf regelmäßige persönliche Zusammenarbeit vor Ort und gelegentliche Dienstreisen zwischen unseren Standorten.Wir prüfen eingehende Bewerbungen fortlaufend und freuen uns, wenn du dich möglichst bald bei uns bewirbst!Bitte lade deine Bewerbung auf Englisch als PDF in unserem Bewerbungsportal hoch und teile uns dabei deine Gehaltsvorstellung sowie deinen frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin mit.Homeoffice:Umfang: Maximal 40%

title: SMD Operators for a New Evening Shift
description:
Are you an experienced SMD Operator with a keen eye for quality, stable processes and precision-driven electronics manufacturing? Do you thrive in a technical environment where you take responsibility, work in a structured manner and actively contribute to a strong team? Then you could be our next experienced SMD Operator at NECAS A/S.About the positionAs an SMD Operator at NECAS, you will play a key role in the operation of our SMD lines – the heart of our electronics manufacturing. You will be responsible for setting up, monitoring and optimising processes, ensuring that production meets our high quality standards.The electronics you help produce are used in everything from industrial and marine applications to defence and aerospace – industries where precision and reliability are essential.You will become part of a highly skilled team and report to the Team Leader.Your responsibilitiesSMD line operation and preparation
  • Operate and monitor SMD equipment, including solder paste printer, SPI, pick-and-place, AOI and reflow oven
  • Prepare the line for production changeovers, including programmes, materials, feeder setup and documentation
  • Ensure stable operation in accordance with production plans and work instructions
  • Work with supporting processes such as the washing machine and stencil cleaner
Quality and inspection
  • Carry out process and quality inspections, including visual inspection and First Article Inspection
  • Analyse AOI results and respond to deviations
  • Ensure the correct handling of materials and components, including batch control, traceability and shelf life
  • Work in accordance with the IPC-A-610 standard (certification provided where required)
  • Record defects and deviations in the quality management system
Collaboration and continuous improvement
  • Ensure good communication and effective handovers between shifts
  • Share knowledge and support colleagues in their daily work
  • Contribute suggestions for improving processes and workflows
  • Maintain order and structure in the SMD area in accordance with 5S principles
About youWe are looking for a candidate who already has solid experience in SMD production and is able to work independently in a technically demanding role.We expect you to:
  • Have a minimum of 3 years' experience with SMD equipment or electronics manufacturing
  • Be structured and able to maintain an overview, even during busy periods
  • Take responsibility and respond quickly when something deviates from the standard
  • Be a team player who contributes positively to the team
  • Have a technical understanding and an interest in working with advanced equipment
  • Language: good command of English, spoken and written
What we offerAt NECAS, you will become part of a growing company where quality and professional expertise are at the heart of what we do. You will receive:
  • A thorough introduction to our processes and equipment
  • Opportunities for relevant training and certifications, such as IPC-A-610
  • A strong team environment and an informal culture with a high level of professional expertise
  • A workplace in Støvring's newest industrial area, close to the E45 motorway
  • Competitive terms of employment, including pension and health insurance
About NECASNECAS is one of Denmark's leading EMS companies, manufacturing electronics for the industrial, marine/offshore, defence, aerospace and scientific sectors – industries where quality and precision are essential.We are one of the few EMS manufacturers in Denmark with AS9100 certification for the aerospace industry. At NECAS, you will become part of a company experiencing significant growth, where you can develop your professional skills and help push the boundaries of Danish electronics manufacturing.As we say: Built for trust.How to applyThe position will be filled as soon as possible. We are inviting candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send your application and CV as soon as possible. We read all applications and will contact candidates we would like to get to know better.If you have any questions, please contact Team Leader Mariana Surleac on +45 92 92 76 20.

title: DIAS Fellow in Integrated Photonics for Computing and Quantum Technologies
description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and SDU Microelectronics, part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME), Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) seek an outstanding candidate to fill a tenure track Fellow (Assistant Professor level) position in the field of Integrated Photonics for Computing and Quantum Technologies. The candidate is expected to start on September 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter, in agreement with the successful candidate. 

We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both IME and DIAS and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard assistant professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities. 

 

Who are we looking for

We seek an experimental researcher whose core expertise is photonic integrated circuits (PICs) and chip-scale photonic technologies. The Fellow will establish an independent, internationally competitive research programme that advances integrated photonic devices, circuits and platforms and uses them to explore emerging computing and quantum technologies.

The position is intentionally anchored in photonic chip technology rather than in a single application domain. Depending on the candidate’s expertise and research vision, the programme may address photonic AI and optical computing, programmable photonic processors, optical interconnects and chip-to-chip communication, quantum photonic circuits and photonic quantum computing, or closely related directions. Candidates are not expected to cover all of these areas.

The Fellow will be based at SDU’s main campus in Odense and will be jointly embedded in SDU Microelectronics at IME and the interdisciplinary environment of DIAS.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

  • A strong commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, contributing to research that bridges multiple fields. 

  • Strong interest in driving internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Engagement in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

 

Research Focus Areas 

The scientific core of the position is the design, realization and experimental validation of integrated photonic technologies. We are particularly interested in candidates who can connect device- and circuit-level innovation to new computing architectures or quantum systems.

Relevant research directions may include, but are not limited to:

  • Photonic integrated circuits (PIC) on silicon, silicon nitride, III–V, thin-film lithium niobate, or other emerging and heterogeneous photonic platforms.

  • Programmable photonic circuits, reconfigurable interferometric or resonator-based networks, nonlinear photonic devices, and integrated sources, modulators and detectors.

  • Photonic and optical computing, including photonic neural networks, optical matrix operations, neuromorphic photonics, analog optical computing, or other hardware approaches for AI and scientific computing.

  • Optical I/O, chip-to-chip optical links, photonic chiplets, co-packaged optics, and energy-efficient interconnects for future computing systems.

  • Quantum photonic integrated circuits, including integrated generation, manipulation, routing and detection of non-classical light, programmable quantum photonics, quantum interconnects, or photonic approaches to quantum information processing and computing.

  • Electronic-photonic co-design, control and readout, packaging and heterogeneous integration linking PICs with CMOS or other electronic technologies.

  • A successful candidate may be strongest in only part of this landscape. The central requirement is a convincing research identity in integrated photonic chip technology and a clear vision for how that expertise can open new scientific questions in computing, quantum technologies, or both.

 

Qualifications

We are looking for a researcher with a clear trajectory toward international research excellence and with the curiosity to build bridges between disciplines. The successful candidate should be able to formulate an independent scientific agenda while engaging constructively with both engineering and fundamental-science environments.

Applicants should demonstrate:

  • A PhD or equivalent qualification in electrical engineering, photonics, applied physics, quantum engineering, materials science, or another closely related field, obtained by the application deadline.

  • Demonstrated research experience gained in diverse institutional and international environments, with a track record of establishing an independent research profile and collaborations beyond the candidate’s current institutional setting.

  • A strong experimental research profile in photonic integrated circuits or closely related chip-scale photonic technologies.

  • Evidence of expertise in PIC design, fabrication or foundry-based realization, experimental characterization, heterogeneous integration, or a closely related photonic-chip workflow.

  • High-quality research output appropriate to career stage and a clear potential to establish an independent and internationally visible research programme.

  • A credible vision for applying integrated photonics to emerging computing and/or quantum technologies.

  • Potential to attract competitive external research funding and to develop international academic and industrial collaborations.

  • A genuine interest in boundary-crossing research and in contributing actively to the intellectual life of DIAS.

  • Strong communication skills and fluency in written and spoken English.

  • Experience with electronic-photonic co-design, advanced packaging, nonlinear photonics, quantum photonics, photonic computing, optical interconnects, or semiconductor foundry ecosystems will be considered an advantage where relevant to the candidate’s proposed programme.

 

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.   

 

About SDU Microelectronics:

SDU Microelectronics is a growing research section within the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering. The section develops integrated circuits and hardware systems for emerging applications and brings together expertise in analog and mixed-signal IC design, neuromorphic and AI hardware, spintronics, sensing, cryogenic electronics and advanced computing systems.

The new Fellow will add a strong photonic-chip dimension to this environment. This creates direct opportunities for joint research in electronic-photonic co-design, photonic accelerators, optical interfaces for AI systems, cryogenic and quantum interfaces, heterogeneous integration, and new computing architectures that combine electronic, photonic and other emerging technologies.

The environment provides access to electronic design, measurement and system-prototyping capabilities and to national and international research and industry networks in semiconductors, photonics and quantum technologies. The Fellow will be encouraged to build an independent group and external funding portfolio while contributing to the long-term development of integrated photonics at SDU.

Read more: SDU Microelectronics (SDU)

 

Additional information

For further information about being a fellow at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk.

For questions about the scientific profile and SDU Microelectronics, please contact Professor Farshad Moradi, Head of SDU Microelectronics: email: moradi@sdu.dk or +45 5386 9444.

 

Application, salary, and employment terms

The position is based at SDU Microelectronics, Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME), in Odense and includes regular participation in DIAS and interdisciplinary collaboration in Odense regularly.

Employment is governed by the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and the provisions for tenure track assistant professor as described herein. Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

The salary comprises a seniority-based base salary and a centrally agreed supplement.

Additional supplements may be negotiated locally.

As of 1 August 2026, the annual salary for an Assistant Professor is DKK 480,224.96 (salary level 6), consisting of a base salary of DKK 417,456 and a supplement of DKK 62,768.96.

All amounts are stated before tax, before added pension (18.07%), and any additional supplements. Pension contributions are paid by SDU, and both salary components (the annual salary and the supplement) are pensionable. For more details on salary and taxation, please see Further information on salary and taxation.

 

 

The tenure track programme is aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area. 

Candidates enter at the assistant professor level (up to six years) and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position as associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee.  This evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential. 

Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. The evaluation may also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities. 

As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution.

The programme includes annual performance reviews, a midterm evaluation by an expert panel, and a final academic assessment. If the final assessment is positive, the candidate will progress to a permanent position as associate professor. If the final evaluation is negative, the assistant professor may request one additional assessment within the last six months of employment. The tenure track period may be extended in connection with maternity, paternity, or adoption leave.

Equal opportunity employmentThe University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

Please go to our website for full information on how to apply.

The application deadline is 28th of February 2027 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

The field of biomedical engineering is interpreted in a broad manner. However, there needs to be clear evidence of (potential) clinical translation and stakeholder engagement for patient impact. It is expected that the successful candidate can move from fundamental science to technology readiness level 6 or above. 

We seek a researcher with expertise in the field of biomedical engineering, who is eager to develop their research career within the DIAS framework. The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

  • Strong interest in driving internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Engagement in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

 

Qualifications

Successful applicants must: 

  • Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of biomedical engineering, computational bioengineering, mechanical or electrical engineering. To qualify for the position as Assistant Professor you must have obtained a PhD or similar degree by the application deadline.  

  • Ability to work well in a team, and coordinate team research.

  • Excellent coding skills and/or exceptional experimental competences.

  • Exhibit curiosity-driven research excellence, thinking beyond traditional boundaries. 

  • Be fluent in English.

  • Show potential for attracting external research funding. Experience in applying for external funding and a strong international network are considered comparative advantages.

  • Have research publications that demonstrate their excellence and broad thinking. 

 

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.    

 

Department of Technology and Innovation

The Department of Technology and Innovation is host to research groups that cross domain-specific boundaries to solve complex problems. The Biomedical Engineering Centre (BEC) at the department conducts interdisciplinary research at the interface of biomechanics, sensing, medical devices, and computational modelling. The successful candidate will join a growing research program focused on creating novel medical technologies. 

BEC is committed to developing engineered solutions that are intuitive, practical, and accessible to clinical users. We use a need-driven approach to ensure the technologies we develop are fit for purpose and directly address real clinical challenges. The centre has strong collaborative ties with leading institutions, such as the University of Oxford, and an international outlook is favored by the Department.

For more questions about the position please contact jberg@iti.sdu.dk (Professor Jeroen Bergmann).

title: DIAS Fellow in Industrial Ecology and Data-Driven Sustainability Assessment
description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and the Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invite applications for a tenure-track DIAS Fellow position at Assistant Professor level in Industrial Ecology and Data-Driven Sustainability Assessment, with a focus on input-output life cycle assessment methods and big data. Who are we looking for?

The position translates this ambition into a concrete research agenda, because many of the most pressing sustainability questions, such as how consumption in one country drives resource use, emissions and social conditions in another, or how a new technology changes environmental impacts across whole economies, cannot be answered within a single discipline. Industrial ecology addresses these questions by tracing material, energy and monetary flows through global supply chains, drawing on methods and data from engineering, economics and the natural and social sciences. Input-output analysis, built on big data covering production, trade, emissions and resource use and combined with life cycle assessment and material flow analysis, provides the quantitative framework for linking decisions about individual products, technologies and policies to their economy-wide consequences. The Fellow will build this capacity at SDU and use DIAS as a platform to work with researchers in fields such as health, food, energy, economics and political science on questions that cross disciplinary boundaries. Within this ambition, the specific profile is as follows.

We seek an early-career researcher who will advance quantitative sustainability assessment within industrial ecology by developing data-driven environmental-economic and systems models that link global production and consumption to environmental and socioeconomic outcomes. The role includes independent research, research-based teaching and supervision, interdisciplinary collaboration across DIAS and the Department, and development of competitive external funding proposals. Relevant research themes include:

·         environmental and material footprinting of global production and consumption systems;

·         development and application of environmentally extended input–output (EEIO) and multi-regional input–output (MRIO) models and databases, including hybrid physical–monetary systems and transparent, reproducible data workflows;

·         hybrid modelling that combines EEIO analysis with life cycle assessment (LCA), material flow analysis (MFA), econometrics or other quantitative methods;

·         applications to food and resource systems, healthcare systems and medical technologies, the circular economy, energy, infrastructure and other societal systems; and

·         scenario, structural decomposition, uncertainty and econometric analysis for sustainability transitions, policy and decision support.

·         Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of industrial ecology, environmental or ecological economics, environmental science or engineering, sustainability science or a closely related field. ·         Exhibit curiosity-driven research excellence, thinking beyond traditional boundaries.

·         Be fluent in English.

The Department of Green Technology at SDU is a dynamic and interdisciplinary research environment focused on developing technologies and strategies for a sustainable future. Our research spans environmental chemistry, process engineering, life cycle thinking, and circular systems. We collaborate closely with industry and public stakeholders to ensure real-world impact and relevance.

This position will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering (SDU LCE).

SDU LCE uses industrial ecology approaches to reduce environmental impacts and reconcile human development with environmental stewardship. title: SMD Operators for a New Evening Shift
description:
Are you an experienced SMD Operator with a keen eye for quality, stable processes and precision-driven electronics manufacturing? Do you thrive in a technical environment where you take responsibility, work in a structured manner and actively contribute to a strong team? Then you could be our next experienced SMD Operator at NECAS A/S.

About the position

As an SMD Operator at NECAS, you will play a key role in the operation of our SMD lines – the heart of our electronics manufacturing. You will be responsible for setting up, monitoring and optimising processes, ensuring that production meets our high quality standards.

The electronics you help produce are used in everything from industrial and marine applications to defence and aerospace – industries where precision and reliability are essential.

You will become part of a highly skilled team and report to the Team Leader.

Your responsibilities

SMD line operation and preparation

  • Operate and monitor SMD equipment, including solder paste printer, SPI, pick-and-place, AOI and reflow oven

  • Prepare the line for production changeovers, including programmes, materials, feeder setup and documentation

  • Ensure stable operation in accordance with production plans and work instructions

  • Work with supporting processes such as the washing machine and stencil cleaner

Quality and inspection

  • Carry out process and quality inspections, including visual inspection and First Article Inspection

  • Analyse AOI results and respond to deviations

  • Ensure the correct handling of materials and components, including batch control, traceability and shelf life

  • Work in accordance with the IPC-A-610 standard (certification provided where required)

  • Record defects and deviations in the quality management system

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Ensure good communication and effective handovers between shifts

  • Share knowledge and support colleagues in their daily work

  • Contribute suggestions for improving processes and workflows

  • Maintain order and structure in the SMD area in accordance with 5S principles

About you

We are looking for a candidate who already has solid experience in SMD production and is able to work independently in a technically demanding role.

We expect you to:

  • Have a minimum of 3 years' experience with SMD equipment or electronics manufacturing

  • Be structured and able to maintain an overview, even during busy periods

  • Take responsibility and respond quickly when something deviates from the standard

  • Be a team player who contributes positively to the team

  • Have a technical understanding and an interest in working with advanced equipment

  • Language: good command of English, spoken and written

What we offer

At NECAS, you will become part of a growing company where quality and professional expertise are at the heart of what we do. You will receive:

  • A thorough introduction to our processes and equipment

  • Opportunities for relevant training and certifications, such as IPC-A-610

  • A strong team environment and an informal culture with a high level of professional expertise

  • A workplace in Støvring's newest industrial area, close to the E45 motorway

  • Competitive terms of employment, including pension and health insurance

About NECAS

NECAS is one of Denmark's leading EMS companies, manufacturing electronics for the industrial, marine/offshore, defence, aerospace and scientific sectors – industries where quality and precision are essential. The company currently has 62 employees.

We are one of the few EMS manufacturers in Denmark with AS9100 certification for the aerospace industry. At NECAS, you will become part of a company experiencing significant growth, where you can develop your professional skills and help push the boundaries of Danish electronics manufacturing.

As we say: Build for trust.

How to apply

The position will be filled as soon as possible. We are inviting candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send your application and CV as soon as possible. Please apply through our website at www.necas.com/karriere. We read all applications and will contact candidates we would like to get to know better.

If you have any questions, please contact Team Leader Mariana Surleac on +45 92 92 76 20.

title: Assistant Professor in Orthopaedic Surgery - Knee Surgery
description:
A position as Assistant Professor (35% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Orthopaedic Surgery, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark.  The position is combined with an employment at Odense University Hospital.

The position is limited to 4 years.

The research unit

The Research Unit of Orthopaedic Surgery provides a dynamic and multidisciplinary research environment and is engaged in a broad range of research activities. Our research spans clinical and experimental as well as epidemiological research, including registry-based research and accident analysis.

Our team consists of both scientific and technical/administrative staff, including professors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, research nurses, secretaries and a laboratory technician.

We have extensive collaborations with other medical specialties and research groups, both nationally and internationally, fostering interdisciplinary research and knowledge exchange.

Research tasks

  • Serve as project lead for the REPLAN research project, with responsibility for its scientific direction, coordination, and overall progress. The REPLAN project investigates whether routine patellar resurfacing reduces patient dissatisfaction and knee pain compared with non-resurfacing in contemporary primary total knee arthroplasty. 

  • Supervise a PhD student, including providing scientific guidance and supporting the progress and completion of the PhD project.

  • Prepare and publish scientific manuscripts in peer-reviewed international journals and present research findings at national and international conferences.

Teaching tasks

  • Contribute to teaching medical students and clinical biomechanics students within orthopaedic surgery, with particular emphasis on knee surgery. 

Expectations and qualifications

The job involves research, professional development, research education, research-based teaching, including exams, supervision within the field of knee surgery. 

The candidate who is hired must complete a Lecturer Training Programme during the period of employment.

The assistant professor must have documented research experience within the area of knee arthroplasty. 

In addition, good cooperation skills are expected in order to further the development of research in the areas mentioned above, both interdisciplinary as well as nationally and internationally. International partners are an advantage, but not a requirement.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information

Further information about the position can be obtained from Head of Research at The Research Unit of Orthopaedic Surgery, Martin Lindberg-Larsen, e-mail: martin.lindberg-larsen@rsyd.dk, phone: +45 2521 3900 or Head of Department of Clinical Research, Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 6550 3477.

Application deadline

December 08, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Assistant Professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed assistant professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Odense University Hospital, J.B. Winsløws Vej 4, 5000 Odense C.   

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (MsC and Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

  • An explanation other qualification relevant to the post

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Site Manager – new biogas plants in Denmark and abroad
description:
Site Manager – new biogas plants in Denmark and abroad

Bigadan is built by people with deep professional expertise and a shared ambition: to create the circular energy solutions of the future. We have been building biogas plants for more than 40 years, in Denmark and abroad, and the coming years are busy. We have expansion and greenfield projects lined up in Denmark and Scandinavia, plus support projects for our clients in Germany and the UK. That is why we are looking for an experienced Site Manager for our Projects team.

Anywhere from 10 to 50+ people from different contractors on site, all needing to deliver at the same time. You are the one holding it all together. And when you hand over, you leave behind a plant that produces biogas for decades.

The role

You lead the site day to day from ground-breaking through commissioning and handover to operations. The people on site are mainly contractors in civil, mechanical, electrical, piping and process works. You report formally to Head of Projects Luke Morris, while Head of Site Managers Stefan Wussow is your manager in day-to-day operations. You work closely with the individual Project Managers and the Site team.

You spend around 80% of your time on site and 20% in the office. Our construction site office and workshop are based in Husum, Germany. Ideally, we would like you to be based in southern Denmark near Kliplev or Husum, but as the role involves a lot of travel, we are recruiting across Denmark and northern Germany. Our projects are spread across Denmark and abroad, including Sweden, Germany, Finland and the UK.

We expect you to be ready for periods of 3–4 weeks living near the site. Employment can be in Denmark or in Germany.

What you do

Site leadership. You coordinate daily activities and contractor progress, plan access, deliveries and lifting operations, and solve problems before they become delays.

Safety. You lead site inspections and toolbox talks and approve risk assessments and method statements. You set the standard on site.

Quality and documentation. You make sure the work follows drawings and specifications, including welding, and keep track of inspections and documentation.

Handover. You manage punch lists and close-out, so we hand over a plant that works from day one.

What makes this role specific

With us, you are not building for a client you will never see again. We operate the plants ourselves afterwards, and our own colleagues will live with what you build for many years. You succeed in this role when you have led the next builds safely to completion, made the right decisions along the way, kept the budget on track, and made both the collaboration and the construction succeed.

We imagine that you:

• have a technical education, e.g. as a mechanical engineer, or a trade background (civil, mechanical or electrical) with hands-on experience

• have at least 5 years' experience as a site manager on industrial, energy, utility or process projects

• know civil, mechanical and electrical works and the health and safety rules on a construction site

• speak and write English and either Danish or German

Experience in biogas or anaerobic digestion is an advantage, but not a requirement. It is also an advantage if you hold a Danish construction safety coordinator certificate (AMK-B), first aid, knowledge of ATEX zones, or experience with welding coordination.

As a person, you are visible on site and make decisions when they need to be made. You can push back on a contractor and still have a good working relationship the next day.

We offer

A central role in a growing company, where you are involved from ground-breaking until the plant is running. You get a competitive salary, either mileage at the official Danish rates or a company van, accommodation and per diem on projects, pension and health insurance, ongoing training and support for relevant certifications. The position is full-time, starting 1 February or 1 March 2027.

About Bigadan

We develop, build, operate and own biogas plants and work across the entire value chain, from sourcing organic residues to producing energy, biogenic CO₂ and biofertiliser. We are around 200 colleagues and have built more than 40 biogas plants in Denmark and abroad.

Every day, we turn manure, food waste and other organic residues into products of value for the energy, agriculture and industrial sectors. This supports security of supply, makes better use of resources and returns nutrients to the soil.

Interested?

The application deadline is Wednesday 30 December 2026. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send your application and CV as soon as possible. If you have questions, please contact Head of Projects Luke Morris on +45 3073 6851 or lm@bigadan.dk.

Shared kitchen, bathroom and laundry facilities. The company provides free access to a washing machine, tumble dryer, electricity, water, heating, internet, and cleaning products for the maintenance of the accommodation provided.

 TAX CARD AND HEALTH INSURANCE CARD

The company will apply for your tax card and health insurance card in accordance with your employment contract. These cards will be valid for the agreed employment period. If you are married, you must provide documentation of your marital status.

TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR FOREIGN EMPLOYEES

Foreign employees working temporarily in Denmark may be eligible for certain tax deductions, depending on their individual tax situation.

 Travel between your home country and Denmark

If you maintain your permanent home in your home country and your personal and financial ties remain there, you may be eligible for a deduction for travel between your home country and your workplace in Denmark. Eligibility depends on your Danish tax status. You must keep documentation of your journeys, such as tickets and receipts. The amount shown for 2026 is approximately DKK 6,000.

Double-household deduction

If your employment in Denmark is temporary and you maintain a home both in Denmark and in your home country, you may, under certain conditions, qualify for a deduction for additional household expenses. This may apply when your work requires you to live away from your permanent home.

To qualify, your employment must generally be temporary, and the distance between the two homes must make daily travel unreasonable. The deduction may be available for up to two years.

For 2026, the standard deduction for double housekeeping is DKK 400 per week without documentation. A higher deduction may be possible if you can document your actual expenses. The total deduction for food, accommodation and double housekeeping is subject to an annual maximum of DKK 34,400 for 2026. 

Important: These deductions are not automatic. You are responsible for checking whether you qualify and for entering the relevant deductions on your Danish tax assessment. Keep your documentation in case the Danish Tax Agency requests it.

TRANSPORT TO DENMARK

You must arrange and pay for your own transport to Denmark.

 If possible, bring your own car. A car can make your stay easier and more convenient, as you may need to travel between different farm locations and your accommodation in nearby houses. It will also give you more freedom to explore the local area.

TRACTOR DRIVING & FORKLIFT CERTIFICATE – ADVANTAGES, NOT REQUIREMENTS

These qualifications are wishes from the company and will be considered positively. However, our main priority is to employ good Team Leaders who can lead people, organize the daily work and take responsibility.

HOW TO APPLY:

If you wish to apply, send an email to job@hyldetoftegaard.dk and you will receive an application form. See more at www.hyldetoftegaard.dk

Applicants wishing to attend an employment interview in Craiova must submit their completed application form and a copy of their ID card in advance.

You will then receive a separate invitation, which must be brought to the interview together with documentation of your previous work experience, as outlined in the instructions

Only qualified applicants will be contacted.

If you do not receive a response from the company within 14 days of submitting your application, please consider that your application has not been successful and that you have not been selected to proceed to the next stage of the recruitment process.

Thank you for your interest and understanding.
