Niveau expert sur Azure Firewall, NSG, WAF et Defender et niveau confirmé sur Azure AD, Azure AD Domain Services, service principals, identités managées, authentification et autorisation,

title: Salg af Hotdogs og Softice på messer i Tyskland
description:
Medarbejder søges til messearbejde i Tyskland - Hotdogs og Softice

Er du serviceminded, fleksibel og klar på et arbejdsliv på farten? Vi søger en medarbejder til en spændende og afvekslende stilling, hvor du sammen med virksomhedens ejer, Jon, rejser rundt til messer i Tyskland og står for salg af danske hotdogs og softice.

 

Om jobbet

Stillingen løber i perioden januar til maj og indebærer deltagelse på forskellige messer rundt omkring i Tyskland. Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift af standen og skal trives med både kundekontakt og praktiske opgaver.

 

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

- Salg og ekspedition af kunder

- Tilberedning og servering af danske hotdogs og softice

- Rengøring og vedligeholdelse af standen

- Opsætning og nedtagning af messestanden

- Transport mellem messerne

- Kørsel med varevogn og stor trailer

 

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med ejeren og bliver en del af et lille team, hvor alle hjælper til med de opgaver, der opstår.

 

Vi forventer, at du:

- Er udadvendt og god til kundeservice

- Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar

- Er praktisk anlagt og ikke bange for fysisk arbejde

- Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider og rejseaktivitet

- Har kørekort til personbil

- Har trailerkørekort (BE), da kørsel med stor trailer er et krav

 

Vi tilbyder

- En spændende hverdag med rejseaktivitet i Tyskland

- Løn efter aftale

- Betalt kost og logi under ophold på messer

- Et tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens ejer

- Et job med stor frihed og afvekslende arbejdsdage

 

Fremtidsmuligheder

For den rette person er der på sigt mulighed for et endnu tættere samarbejde. Der kan blive tale om at indgå i et partnerskab i virksomheden eller på længere sigt overtage forretningen helt.

 

Ansøgning

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning og fortæl lidt om dig selv, din erfaring og hvorfor du kunne tænke dig et job med masser af kundekontakt, rejser og ansvar.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

title: Supply Chain Experte (w/m/d) (Supply-Chain-Manager/in)

Wertschätzung, Eigenverantwortung und flache Hierarchien prägen unsere Arbeitsgemeinschaft – ebenso wie der Gestaltungswille und die Initiative aller Mitarbeitenden. Denn nur zusammen sind wir erfolgreich.• Gesundheit & Vorsorge: Wir bieten Dir zahlreiche individuelle Zusatzleistungen. Dich erwarten ein Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, eine Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung, viele Angebote für die mentale und körperliche Gesundheit, Kooperationen mit Krankenkassen und hauseigene Kurse.• Lernen bei dm: Bilde Dich in der digitalen dm-Lernwelt zu vielen verschiedenen Themen weiter – vom Projektmanagement bis zum Sprachkurs unterstützen Dich unsere Angebote in Deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung.• Arbeitsatmosphäre: Unsere Räume im "dialogicum" sind hell, großzügig und modern. Die neueste Technik und ergonomisches Mobiliar erleichtern Dir Deine Aufgaben. Im "culinarium" bieten wir Dir täglich frische Mahlzeiten, gesunde Snacks und süße Kleinigkeiten zum fairen Preis.• Arbeitsbedingungen: Für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance sorgen flexibles und mobiles Arbeiten, unsere 37,5-Stunden-Woche und 30 Urlaubstage. Du kannst Arbeit und Urlaub sogar bei einer "Workation" im europäischen Ausland verbinden.• Zusatzleistungen: Den Erfolg unserer Arbeitsgemeinschaft geben wir gern an Dich zurück – mit Zulagen wie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld, mit Sonderzahlungen und Warengutscheinen. Du bekommst außerdem 10 % Mitarbeiterrabatt in allen deutschen dm-Märkten und profitierst in vielen Onlineshops von exklusiven Angeboten für dm-Mitarbeitende. Darüber hinaus kannst Du zweimal jährlich aktuelle Smartphones, Tablets oder Laptops für Deinen Privatgebrauch preiswert leasen.• Mobilität: Mit einem Zuschuss für das "Deutschlandticket Job" bist Du günstig unterwegs. Wenn Du lieber Fahrrad fährst, kannst Du auch das JobRad® nutzen. Auf unserem Gelände gibt es genügend Parkplätze, E-Ladestationen und eine Fahrradgarage. Eine S-Bahn-Station und der Anschluss zur Autobahn liegen in direkter Nähe.

B. title: Dean (m/f/d): School of Science (Professor/in - Hochschulen)
description: The Executive Board and Provost of Constructor University invite applications for the position ofDean (m/f/d) of the School of Science(Full-time; 38.5 hours/week, limited to 5 years)The expected starting date is 01.09.2027.  A regular presence on campus in Bremen is required.About Constructor UniversityConstructor University (CU) is a private, research-driven, international university in Germany, with students from more than 100 countries. Three schools—Science,  Computer Science and Engineering, and Business, Social and Decision Sciences,   - offer interdisciplinary undergraduate, graduate and doctoral programs committed to excellence in teaching, research, and innovation in higher education.In 2022, CU has become part of the global Constructor ecosystem, with its three complementing pillars (Constructor Knowledge, including  CU; Constructor Tech, focusing on digital solutions for teaching and  learning; and Constructor Capital, an early-stage capital firm investing in Deep Tech, Software, and Edtech). About the School of ScienceThe School of Science brings together basic and applied research with research-led education in an international and interdisciplinary environment. With particular strengths in the natural and life sciences, including physics, chemistry, mathematics, and biological sciences, the School currently offers 6 Bachelor and 2 interdisciplinary Master programs to around 350 students. Students benefit from close interaction with faculty, access to modern laboratories and research facilities, and opportunities to participate in research from an early stage of their studies. Further development of the School of Science is a strategic objective of the university, particularly in the areas of physics and quantum sciences.Your ResponsibilitiesThe Dean of the School of Science is responsible for the academic leadership, strategic development, and effective management of the School. The Dean oversees academic staffing, including workforce planning, faculty recruitment, performance evaluation, and professional development, ensuring that the School has the expertise and capacity required to deliver its teaching and research objectives. The Dean is responsible for developing and managing the School's budget, allocating resources effectively, and ensuring financial sustainability. Working with faculty and university leadership, the Dean leads the development, review, and improvement of study programs, ensuring academic quality, relevance, innovation, and alignment with student needs and emerging scientific developments. The Dean also develops and implements the School's long-term strategy, identifying opportunities for research excellence, new academic programs, interdisciplinary collaboration, external partnerships, and revenue generation, while ensuring alignment with the University's overall mission, priorities, and institutional strategy. The Dean is accountable for the School's academic performance, financial management, and contribution to the University's success.Role RequirementsThe Dean is expected to provide academic leadership while fostering a collaborative, international, and innovative academic environment. Candidates should:- Demonstrate the ability to provide strategic leadership for the academic development of the School in alignment with the university’s mission and long-term goals- Lead and mentor a diverse faculty body while supporting professional development- Develop interdisciplinary collaboration both within and across schools- Strengthen the School’s international profile and academic partnerships- Foster innovation in digital and emerging forms of teaching and learning- Manage resources effectively, including budget planning and strategic allocation of funds- Represent the School within the university and externally to academic, scientific, and industry stakeholders.Your QualificationsDeans should radiate academic and intellectual gravitas and display evident leadership qualities. Their academic and scientific experience and insight should be at the level where they are respected as accomplished academics both within Constructor University and in the broader academic community. In particular, as senior academics and managers at Constructor University, Deans must- have a Ph.D. in a field of the school and teaching and research experience of at least ten years- hold a full professorship or equivalent- have a proven track record of hands-on experience with the European/German research grant landscape- exhibit previous personal involvement in relevant high-level academic administrative processes and leadership activities in a relevant academic or scientific institution- present evidence of strategic thinking and management- have an understanding of the economic and strategic context of academic and scientific activities in a university- possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and demonstrate the ability to work in and with teams- express familiarity with international higher education structures and landscapes- exhibit fluency in English, the medium of instruction at Constructor UniversityWhat you can expect at Constructor UniversityWe are an international, world-class private university embarking on an exciting journey of growth and expanding our portfolio. Join us and become a part of our global teams! We offer:- Individual on-boarding, career- and development planning- Company fitness program offers with EGYM Well Pass- In collaboration with Deutsche Dienstrad – Lease a company bike, whether it's a bicycle, road bike, or e-bike, for both private and business use.- 30 days of annual leave, plus additional days off for special occasions- Green campus with extensive dining options and recreation areas, take the tour: Campus (https://constructor.university/student-life/campus-life/campus/virtual-tour)- Constructor University has extensive programs on sustainability, environmental sustainability, equal opportunities and high ethical valuesConstructor University unequivocally guarantees the academic freedom of every member of the faculty, as well as every other member of the Constructor University community. We encourage diversity in the University in ethnic, cultural, social, religious, political, and national backgrounds, as well as in individual lifestyle. Constructor University offers full equality of opportunity to all qualified applicants and is an equal opportunity employer.Your ApplicationFor any further information regarding this position, please contact our Recruiter, Doro Hartmann, via Mail (job-application@constructor.university).Apply today - it's simple and uncomplicated. We look forward to getting to know you.A complete application includes the following materials:- Cover letter,- Curriculum vitae with a publication list,- Statement on your academic vision for the school of Science,- Copies of certificates and diplomas,- At least two potential referees (with contact data and affiliations) need to be mentioned in the CV.The deadline for submission of applications is January 03, 2027 (EOB).The review of applications will begin immediately.Please note that only applications submitted through the official application portal will be considered for recognition.Incomplete applications will not be considered.

title: Manager Production Planning (m/w/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Fachschule) - Produktionswirtschaft/Bachelor Professional in Wirtschaft)
description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Teamleiter ProduktionsplanungStellenbeschreibung:Wenn Du als Manager Production Planning (m/w/d) auf der Suche nach einer Möglichkeit bist, Deine Karriere weiterzuentwickeln, bietet Dir diese Position die Chance, einen wesentlichen Beitrag zu einer leistungsstarken und kundenorientierten Produktionsorganisation zu leisten. Du verantwortest die integrierte Bedarfs-, Kapazitäts- und Produktionsplanung und stellst sicher, dass Kundenaufträge, Materialverfügbarkeit und Fertigungsressourcen optimal aufeinander abgestimmt sind. Gemeinsam mit vielfältigen Teams trägst Du dazu bei, Liefertermine einzuhalten, Bestände zielgerichtet zu steuern und unsere Planungs- und Steuerungsprozesse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.In dieser Rolle wirst Du:- Das Team der Produktionsplanung führen, fördern und bei der erfolgreichen Umsetzung gemeinsamer Ziele unterstützen.- Die mittel- und kurzfristige Produktions-, Kapazitäts- und Auftragsplanung unter Berücksichtigung von Kundenanforderungen, Materialverfügbarkeit und verfügbaren Ressourcen verantworten.- Kunden- und Produktionsaufträge priorisieren und steuern, um eine hohe Liefertreue sowie eine effiziente Ressourcennutzung sicherzustellen.- Eng mit den Bereichen Vertrieb, Auftragsmanagement, Einkauf, Logistik, Produktion und Qualität zusammenarbeiten, um abgestimmte Planungsentscheidungen zu treffen.- Die integrierte Absatz-, Bedarfs- und Produktionsplanung aktiv mitgestalten und den S&OP-Prozess unterstützen.- Planungsparameter, Kapazitätsmodelle sowie planungsrelevante Stammdaten in ERP- und MRP-Systemen pflegen und kontinuierlich optimieren.- Relevante Kennzahlen analysieren, aussagekräftige Reportings erstellen und Verbesserungspotenziale identifizieren.- Risiken hinsichtlich Materialverfügbarkeit, Kapazitäten oder Lieferterminen frühzeitig erkennen und geeignete Gegenmaßnahmen koordinieren.- Maßnahmen zur Standardisierung, Digitalisierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Planungs- und Steuerungsprozesse initiieren und umsetzen.- Die Einhaltung von Unternehmensrichtlinien, Qualitätsstandards und definierten Prozessen in Deinem Verantwortungsbereich sicherstellen.Wer Du bist:Du übernimmst Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Vereinbarungen und Ziele zuverlässig erreicht werden. Mit Energie und Engagement gehst Du neue Herausforderungen an und nutzt Chancen, um Verbesserungen voranzutreiben. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, arbeitest erfolgreich mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitige Unterstützung selbstverständlich sind. Komplexe Informationen analysierst Du strukturiert, leitest fundierte Entscheidungen daraus ab und setzt klare Prioritäten. Durch Deine ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise gelingt es Dir, nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Teams zu fördern.Für diese Rolle bringst Du mit:- Erfahrung in der Produktionsplanung, Produktionssteuerung oder im Supply Chain Management eines produzierenden Unternehmens.- Erfahrung in der Führung von Mitarbeitenden oder in der erfolgreichen Koordination funktionsübergreifender Planungsprozesse.- Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Bedarfs-, Kapazitäts- und Produktionsplanung.- Ein gutes Verständnis von Supply-Chain-Prozessen sowie deren Schnittstellen zu Einkauf, Produktion, Logistik, Vertrieb und Auftragsmanagement.- Erfahrung im Umgang mit ERP- und MRP-Systemen.- Kenntnisse in der Auftragspriorisierung, Materialverfügbarkeitsprüfung, Terminplanung sowie im Engpass- und Eskalationsmanagement.- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie einen sicheren Umgang mit Microsoft Excel.- Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Koordinationsfähigkeiten in einem bereichsübergreifenden Umfeld.- Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.Zusätzliche Qualifikationen, die Dich auszeichnen:- Erfahrung mit integrierten Sales-, Operations- und Produktionsplanungsprozessen (S&OP).- Kenntnisse von Business-Intelligence-, Reporting- oder Analysewerkzeugen.- Erfahrung in der Digitalisierung und Optimierung von Planungs- und Steuerungsprozessen.- Erfahrung in einem internationalen Produktions- oder Supply-Chain-Umfeld.- Kenntnisse in Lean-, Continuous-Improvement- oder Operational-Excellence-Methoden.Unsere Kultur und unser Versprechen an Dich:Bei Emerson schaffen wir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem jede Person wertgeschätzt, respektiert und dabei unterstützt wird, sich weiterzuentwickeln. Wir fördern eine Kultur, die Innovation, Zusammenarbeit und unterschiedliche Perspektiven stärkt, denn wir sind überzeugt, dass die besten Ideen aus starken und vielfältigen Teams entstehen.Unser Engagement für kontinuierliche persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung sowie für eine inklusive Unternehmenskultur stellt sicher, dass Du die Unterstützung erhältst, die Du benötigst, um erfolgreich zu sein. Ob durch Mentoring, Weiterbildungsangebote oder Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten im Leadership-Bereich – wir investieren in Deinen Erfolg, damit Du nachhaltig Wirkung erzielen und einen wertvollen Beitrag leisten kannst.Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass vielfältige Teams, die gemeinsam auf gemeinsame Ziele hinarbeiten, entscheidend für Wachstum, Innovation und nachhaltigen Unternehmenserfolg sind.Bei Emerson erwarten Dich spannende Herausforderungen, internationale Zusammenarbeit und die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten. Wir unterstützen Dich dabei, Deine Stärken einzubringen, neue Kompetenzen zu entwickeln und Deine Karriere langfristig weiterzuentwickeln.Homeoffice:Umfang: Maximal 20%

title: Salg af Hotdogs og Softice på messer i Tyskland
description:
Medarbejder søges til messearbejde i Tyskland - Hotdogs og Softice

Er du serviceminded, fleksibel og klar på et arbejdsliv på farten? Vi søger en medarbejder til en spændende og afvekslende stilling, hvor du sammen med virksomhedens ejer, Jon, rejser rundt til messer i Tyskland og står for salg af danske hotdogs og softice.

 

Om jobbet

Stillingen løber i perioden januar til maj og indebærer deltagelse på forskellige messer rundt omkring i Tyskland. Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift af standen og skal trives med både kundekontakt og praktiske opgaver.

 

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

- Salg og ekspedition af kunder

- Tilberedning og servering af danske hotdogs og softice

- Rengøring og vedligeholdelse af standen

- Opsætning og nedtagning af messestanden

- Transport mellem messerne

- Kørsel med varevogn og stor trailer

 

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med ejeren og bliver en del af et lille team, hvor alle hjælper til med de opgaver, der opstår.

 

Vi forventer, at du:

- Er udadvendt og god til kundeservice

- Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar

- Er praktisk anlagt og ikke bange for fysisk arbejde

- Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider og rejseaktivitet

- Har kørekort til personbil

- Har trailerkørekort (BE), da kørsel med stor trailer er et krav

 

Vi tilbyder

- En spændende hverdag med rejseaktivitet i Tyskland

- Løn efter aftale

- Betalt kost og logi under ophold på messer

- Et tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens ejer

- Et job med stor frihed og afvekslende arbejdsdage

 

Fremtidsmuligheder

For den rette person er der på sigt mulighed for et endnu tættere samarbejde. Der kan blive tale om at indgå i et partnerskab i virksomheden eller på længere sigt overtage forretningen helt.

 

Ansøgning

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning og fortæl lidt om dig selv, din erfaring og hvorfor du kunne tænke dig et job med masser af kundekontakt, rejser og ansvar.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

description: RESPONSABILITÉS : Le poste de monteur de systèmes de ventilation a pour objectif principal d'assurer l'installation, le montage et la mise en place des réseaux de ventilation et de gaines d'air sur des sites industriels, tertiaires ou résidentiels, en garantissant la conformité aux plans et aux normes de sécurité, notamment pour les travaux en hauteur. Le rôle contribue directement au bon déroulement des chantiers et à la performance énergétique des installations de l'entreprise. - préparer et organiser les interventions sur chantier à partir des plans, schémas et consignes techniques, - assembler et poser les gaines de ventilation, conduits et accessoires (bouches, grilles, caissons, supports) - réaliser les raccordements nécessaires. Le ou la titulaire du poste intervient fréquemment en hauteur pour la fixation des réseaux, en utilisant les équipements de protection et de levage adaptés, et s'assure de la stabilité, de l'étanchéité et de l'alignement des installations. - vérification du bon fonctionnement mécanique des systèmes installés, la réalisation d'ajustements ou de reprises si nécessaire, ainsi que la participation aux essais et aux contrôles de conformité.PROFIL RECHERCHÉ : Le profil recherché dispose impérativement d'une formation industrielle de type CAP ou Bac professionnel, idéalement orientée vers le montage industriel, la pose de structures métalliques ou les métiers liés au secteur énergétique. - Diplôme de niveau CAP, BEP ou Bac Pro dans les domaines de la mécanique industrielle, chaudronnerie, structures métalliques, maintenance industrielle, installation d'équipements ou filière équivalente du secteur énergétique. - Maîtrise des techniques de montage, d'assemblage et de pose de structures industrielles (mécaniques, métalliques, supports, charpentes, équipements)Expérience et réalisations  - Une première expérience en atelier ou sur chantier dans le montage d'installations industrielles, la pose de structures ou l'installation d'équipements du secteur énergétique est fortement souhaitée. - Expérience dans le travail en équipe sur sites industriels, chantiers extérieurs ou installations énergétiques (centrales, réseaux, postes, etc.) appréciée. - Habitude de travailler dans le respect de procédures, consignes techniques et plannings d'intervention, - la maitrise de la langue allemande est nécessaire du fait que le poste est en Allemagne et au sein d'une équipe allemande.

title: Personalsachbearbeiter*in (d/w/m) (Personalsachbearbeiter/in)
description: InformationenJedes Kind hat das Recht auf eine Zukunft. In Deutschland und weltweit arbeiten wir als größte unabhängige Kinderrechtsorganisation mit aller Kraft dafür, dass Kinder gesund aufwachsen, lernen können und geschützt werden, auch in Krisenzeiten. In unseren Projekten beteiligen wir sie und setzen uns gemeinsam mit ihnen für ihre Zukunft ein.Um unsere Arbeit gerechter und machtsensibler zu gestalten, möchten wir Raum für Perspektiven marginalisierter Personen schaffen. Wir sind auf dem Weg, uns verstärkt mit den Themen Diversität, Gerechtigkeit, Inklusion und Anti-Rassismus sowie den Diskriminierungspotenzialen in unseren eigenen Strukturen und Prozessen auseinanderzusetzen.In unserem Team Human Resources möchten wir die PositionPersonalsachbearbeiterin (d/w/m)* in Teilzeit (20 Std./Wo.) zum 01.01.2027und zunächst auf 2 Jahre befristet besetzen.Ihre Aufgaben:- Erstellung von Arbeitsverträgen, Vertragsänderungen, Arbeitszeugnissen, Bescheinigungen usw.- Erstellung von Betriebsratsanhörungen- Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte zu personalrelevanten Fragestellungen- Personalmanagement des Bereiches F2F-Fundraising- Stammdaten- und Zeiterfassungspflege in unserem Personalmanagementsystem REXX- Steuerung des Offboarding-Prozesses- Nachhalten von Fristen- Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung interner Strukturen- Koordination des Gesundheitsmanagements der Organisation (Teilnahme an ASA-Sitzungen, Kontakt zur Betriebsärztin, usw.)- Bei Bedarf Unterstützung des Teams bei weiteren AufgabenIhre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen:- abgeschlossene kaufmännische Berufsausbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation und relevante Berufserfahrung- erste Erfahrung im Bereich Human Resources, insbesondere in administrativen und organisatorischen Personalprozessen- gute Kenntnisse im Arbeits-, Lohnsteuer- und Sozialversicherungsrecht- gute Kenntnisse in MS Office (Teams, Outlook, Word, Excel, Powerpoint)- sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift- ein hohes Maß an Loyalität, Integrität und Diskretion für die Arbeit mit personenbezogenen Daten und ThemenUnser Angebot- flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung und bis zu 60% mobiles Arbeiten- Bezahlung nach organisationsinternem Gehaltsmodell; das Startgehalt für diese Position liegt zwischen 1.500 € und 1.820 € (brutto Teilzeit bei 20h / Woche), je nach relevanter Berufserfahrung und Expertise- professionelle Unterstützung und Maßnahmen zur Weiterentwicklung- ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld und eine wertebasierte Organisationskultur- viel Raum für Selbstständigkeit und Eigeninitiative- 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr plus 1 Tag Sonderurlaub- Auswahl eines zusätzlichen Benefits:Edenred-Guthabenkarte, zusätzliche betriebliche Krankenversicherung, Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft bzw. 80% Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket Job- auf Wunsch 20 % Beteiligung an der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge- volle Entgeltfortzahlung bei Erkrankung des Kindes- betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement- Familienraum sowie Ruhe- und Gebetsraum in unserem Büro- ArbeitslaptopGrundsätze unserer ArbeitWir unternehmen alles, um Kinder im Rahmen unserer Arbeit vor Gefahren zu schützen. Deshalb setzen wir die Bereitschaft voraus, nach den** ** Child Safeguarding Standards  von Save the Children zu handeln und benötigen bei einer Einstellung die Vorlage eines erweiterten Führungszeugnisses.Wir arbeiten daran, nicht auf die gesamtgesellschaftlich bestehende strukturelle Diskriminierung einzuzahlen. Uns ist wichtig, Begegnungen zwischen Menschen zu fördern und sie sicher für alle zu gestalten. Wir ermutigen Menschen, die marginalisierten Gruppen zugehörig sind oder Diskriminierung erfahren haben, sich bei uns zu bewerben.  Mehr Informationen finden Sie hier: Unsere Haltung_Um zu mehr Transparenz unserer Interessen gegenüber der Politik beizutragen, verpflichten wir uns und unsere Interessenvertreter*innen zur Eintragung in das beim Deutschen Bundestag geführte _Lobbyregister .Hinweise zur BewerbungBitte senden Sie uns bis zum 13.12.2026 Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Qualifikationsnachweise, Arbeitszeugnisse /Referenzen) über unser Bewerbungsportal zu.** Die Interviews für diese Rolle werden am 17.12. und 18.12.2026 in Berlin stattfinden.**Sie erfüllen noch nicht alle Anforderungen?  Wir schätzen motivierte Quereinsteiger*innen mit unterschiedlichen Erfahrungen und passenden Fähigkeiten.Barrierefreiheit : Noch sind nicht alle Bereiche unserer Arbeit barrierefrei, teilen Sie uns gern in Ihrer Bewerbung mit, was für Sie wichtig ist. title: Program Development & Award Advisor (d/f/m), Latin America (Fundraiser/in)
employer: Intern. Rescue Committee IRC Deutschland gGmbH
description: IRC (International Rescue Committee) Germany is seeking aProgram Development & Award Advisor (d/f/m), Latin America- in Berlin, or remote (within Germany) | as soon as possible- in part-time (20 hours/week), increase to full-time in the future might be possible (contingent upon funding) | initially for 2 yearsAbout UsFounded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC offers lifesaving care and life-changing assistance to refugees forced to flee from war or disaster. In 2016, IRC Germany was founded and engages in global humanitarian work as well as throughout Germany in the areas of education, economic wellbeing, and safety, legal protection, and empowerment.IRC’s Crisis Response, Recovery and Development Department (CRRD) runs humanitarian relief, recovery, and development programs focused on safety, health, education, economic well-being, and people’s power to influence decisions, with particular attention to women and girls. Its Awards Management Unit (AMU) secures and manages government donor funding, bridging donors and country programs while ensuring compliance and managing risk. In Latin America and the Caribbean, the IRC responds to crises in Colombia, Ecuador, Venezuela, Mexico, Central America, and Haiti, supporting displaced and host communities through local partners and direct implementation. The Program Development and Award Advisor (PDAA) provides pre- and post-award support to country offices, ensures donor and IRC compliance, leads donor deliverables, and manages donor relationships.Major Responsibilities- Strategic Business Development: support country offices in advancing strategic business development planning efforts, donor engagement, intelligence gathering, positioning and capture. Prepare for and participate in donor meetings, engagement calls, and strategic discussions as needed. - Proposal development: provide quality assurance and quality compliance support on proposals, leading proposal development and coordination as needed. Ensure responsiveness to and compliance with solicitation documents and with IRC’s requirements and policies. - Award portfolio management: manage a portfolio of awards and act as the first point of contact for country award staff on compliance issues. Review agreements and lead negotiation of award terms and conditions with donor counterparts. - Partnerships: guide country offices in managing local and international partners in line with IRC’s PEERs system, and review and process sub-grant agreements. - Monitoring: monitor projects to ensure progress against objectives and compliance with donor guidelines and IRC internal requirements. Monitoring awards can take the shape of monitoring visits, participation in routine meetings and other regular calls. - Experience writing, reviewing and editing funding proposals and other donor deliverables and excellent attention to detail.- Excellent written and oral communication skills, including experience in speaking on relevant issues with internal and external audiences.- English and Spanish language skills at C1-level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CERF) (https://www.europaeischer-referenzrahmen.de/) . Additional knowledge of French and/or German highly desirable.- Solid organizational and creative problem-solving skills: ability to be flexible and work well under pressure in a fast-paced multi-tasking team environment- Excellent IT skills (Word, Outlook, Excel)- Ability and willingness to travel internationally (up to 15 %)- Reporting: provide timely support on narrative reporting, amendments, and modifications. Ensure timely submission of high-quality donor deliverables.- Donor liaison: manage donor relationships on contractual issues, compliance queries and approvals, and represent IRC externally at events and meetings.- Capacity building: mentor Grants and Partnerships staff, develop and deliver training, and support recruitment and onboarding of new team members.- Other duties: contribute to AMU and regional strategic priorities, work with communications teams on donor communication products, and maintain checklists and work processes and systems. Your Profile- Significant work experience in award management or business development with EU donors, particularly ECHO, and other public donors. Experience with and a strong understanding of institutional donors’ compliance requirements.- Two years of international field experience highly desirable, familiarity with countries in the region preferred.- Excellent interpersonal & communication skills: ability to successfully and effectively liaise with people within and across departments in a multi-cultural environment.- Good financial management and budgeting skills- Ability to analyze and synthesize information, work collaboratively as part of a diverse team, handle complex tasks, and work independently We Offer- Meaningful work within a collaborative team- A starting salary between 32.000 and 33.500 Euro gross per year (for part-time, 20 hours/week) as well as an annual salary increase- Attractive employee benefits such as gym membership, company pension scheme, shopping vouchers, childcare subsidy, job bike leasing, subsidized Deutschlandticket (national public transport), and access to timely and confidential psychological support if needed- 30 days of annual leave and special leave days- Flexible hybrid-work options (working hours, office/homebased)- Training and professional development opportunities, including access to free language courses- Assistance services for people with disabilities, if required.We look forward to receiving your application (including CV and – if available – three references) via our application portal (https://theirc.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/de-DE/External_Careers/job/Berlin-Germany/Program-Development---Award-Advisor--d-f-m---Latin-America_JR00006189) – even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. For questions, please contact Friederike Haarbrücker (HR.Deutschland@rescue.org (https://mailto:HR.Deutschland@rescue.org) ).As an organization committed to an empowering work environment, equal opportunities, and against any form of discrimination, we welcome applications from people regardless of their origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disabilities, age, or other characteristics protected by applicable law. We particularly encourage people with personal or family experience of flight and migration to apply.With equal qualifications, we give preference to applications from people with severe disabilities. If you have any questions about accessible applications or inclusion, please feel free to contact our Inclusion Officer, Christine Mader (christine.mader@rescue.org (https://mailto:christine.mader@rescue.org) ).To ensure equal opportunities, we kindly ask you to refrain from including photos in your application documents.There is no specific application deadline for this job posting. The position needs to be filled as soon as possible and will remain posted until filled.All IRC workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct (https://www.rescue.org/page/our-code-conduct) . On this basis, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding (https://www.rescue.org/page/safeguarding) , Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Anti-Retaliation.You can find more information about IRC Germany at IRCDeutschland.org (https://www.irc-deutschland.org/) .Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

title: Teamleitung Fertigung (m/w/d)
description: 1 Teamleitung Fertigung (m/w/d) Arbeitsort: SopronDarum dreht sich Ihre Rolle * Analyse, Vorbereitung und Konzeption ** Sie analysieren die bestehende Fertigung bei unserem bisherigen Lieferanten direkt vor Ort und dokumentieren die Abläufe lückenlos. ** Auf Basis der Daten setzen Sie das bestehende Fertigungskonzept konkret um und bringen sich aktiv in die Feinplanung sowie das Hallenlayout ein, um von Beginn an maximale Effizienz zu sichern. * Prototypenbau, Optimierung und Schnittstellenarbeit ** Sie koordinieren, steuern und unterstützen das Team beim Aufbau des Prototyps auf Basis des zugelieferten Bausatzes. ** Sie analysieren die Effizienz, vervollständigen notwendige Prozessdokumentationen im Dialog mit den Beteiligten und bauen ein System zur Qualitätssicherung in allen Fertigungsschritten auf. ** Sie geben technisches Feedback an das technische Büro zurück und arbeiten eng mit den zentralen Abteilungen (Technik und Projektleitung), der lokalen Geschäfts- und Werksleitung sowie den lokalen Meister:innen zusammen. * Serienüberführung, Arbeitsvorbereitung und Logistik ** Sie bereiten die AV vor, legen Losgrößen für Einzelteile fest und sichern die reibungslose Bereitstellung von Halbzeugen im Standardablauf des neuen Partners. ** Sie erstellen den Fertigungs- und Kapazitätsplan passgenau auf Basis unserer Bestellungen und Liefertermine. ** Sie überführen den Prototypen erfolgreich in die Serienfertigung und wirken parallel an der Entwicklung neuer Prototypen mit. ** Sie tragen die Verantwortung dafür, dass das Endprodukt nach unseren vorgegebenen Standards verpackt und transportiert wird. ** Sie führen und motivieren Ihr Team von 4-10 Personen mit klarem Blick für das gemeinsame Ziel.Diese Kenntnisse können Sie verwerten * Sie verfügen über einen Meistertitel in einem metallverarbeitenden Beruf oder einen HTL-Abschluss mit Matura. Zudem bringen Sie solide handwerkliche Erfahrung und idealerweise bereits Einblicke in die Arbeitsvorbereitung mit. * Sie bringen idealerweise fundierte Praxis aus dem Stahlbau oder der Fertigungstechnologie mit. * Sie haben nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Fertigung komplexer technischer Vorrichtungen sowie in der Serienfertigung. * Sie zeichnen sich durch eine hohe Detailorientierung aus, bringen Ideen konsequent auf die Straße und lassen sich auch von engen Zeitplänen nicht aus der Ruhe bringen. * Da Sie viele Schnittstellen koordinieren, überzeugen Sie durch ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, diplomatisches Geschick und die Fähigkeit, gemeinsame Lösungen zu finden. * Sie haben bereits erste Erfahrung in der Führung von Mitarbeiter:innen gesammelt und verstehen es, Ihr Team zu motivieren und zu inspirieren. * Kenntnisse über Arbeitssicherheit und Arbeitnehmer:innenschutz im modernen Fertigungsumfeld sind für Sie selbstverständlich. * Sichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend erforderlich. Da sich die Fertigung vor Ort befinden, sind ungarische Sprachkenntnisse kein Muss, aber ein willkommener Bonus, um die Kommunikation vor Ort noch reibungsloser zu gestalten.Dieses Angebot bereiten wir für Sie vor * Eine abwechslungsreiche Position in einem internationalen Unternehmen, in einem interessanten, rasch wachsenden und innovativen Bereich * Ein engagiertes und dynamisches Team * Firmen-Events * Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg * flexible ArbeitszeitenJe nach Qualifikation und Vorerfahrung liegt das Grundgehalt bei dieser Position zwischen EUR 5.000,-- und EUR 6.000,-- brutto monatlich.Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie die Zukunft gemeinsam mit uns!Das AMS Baden wurde durch den Betrieb mit der Vorauswahl betraut.Bitte senden Sie Ihre aussagekräftigen schriftlichen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit folgenden Angaben in der Betreffzeile*U03-17423824*vorzugsweise per Mail an: bewerbung.baden@ams.atBei Mailbewerbungen Speichergröße von 3MB nicht überschreiten!bzw. per Post anAMS Baden * Service für Unternehmen *Nicole Vordre...

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Fenris Creations is looking for a Senior Software Engineer!The infrastructure team owns the core platform that powers EVE Online, building a reliable foundation that will scale and grow with our players over time. As a senior engineer on the team, you’ll own large, open-ended projects, such as making login faster and safer, letting a node fail without ending a fleet engagement, or finding where the latency in an RPC path goes. You’ll define the problem, propose a direction, split the work into pieces that each ship something useful, and build them with the team, supporting our most critical workloads.Your Tasks:Take a goal like “improve authentication”, talk to the people it affects, and write a design that breaks it into milestones.Lay out the tradeoffs (reliability, cost, effort, risk) and bring the team and stakeholders to an agreement.Write production code, mostly in Go, from service interfaces and data models to the messaging between services, and take your design through review to launch.Estimate throughput, storage and latency before you build, then load test and failure test the result.Work out how state is partitioned, replicated and cached, so a bad node degrades one region while the rest of the cluster keeps running.Explain your designs to engineers and non-technical stakeholders, review other people’s work, and mentor.Your Profile:You push clean, tested code in at least one language, such as Go, Python, Rust, Java, C++, C# or TypeScript. We write mostly in Go and expect you to pick it up quickly if you don’t know it.You break large, ambiguous problems into smaller ones and work through them systematically.You can design a system end to end, with realistic estimates for each component, and explain the tradeoffs.You know data structures and complexity, concurrency, how data stores behave as they grow, and why networks and services fail.You’ve led a project from a fuzzy idea to a shipped result, delivering in increments.You use excellent written and spoken communication skills to communicate and influence technical choices clearly, tailoring trade-offs for each audience.You measure what you build and use the data to choose what comes next.You may lean toward software design or toward how systems fit together, but a blend of both is the perfect sweet spot.Nice to have:Prior hands-on experience with distributed systems patterns: RPC, pub/sub, message queues, event streaming, replication, partitioning.Prior experience running services on AWS, Azure or Kubernetes.Prior exposure to tracing, metrics and structured logging (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus or similar).Philosophical inclinations towards infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible or similar).Prior experience with enough UNIX and networking (TCP/IP, load balancing) to debug your own systems.A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.What We Can Offer You:The inspiring opportunity of working on the award winning MMO EVE Online in cooperation with amazingly talented and passionate co-workers.A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.Double work station setup and flexible work environment.A lively fun division that hosts regular events.An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.Annual sports grant.A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.Home internet.A conditional monthly transportation grant.Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.Relocation Package.Please submit your application in English: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/5d2d81e1-174f-4d78-b0cb-ff3a6bd24b4eApplication deadline: Deceember 31st, 2026

title: Ræstingar ofl.
description: Leitað er eftir starfsmanni í hlutastarf við Orlofsbyggðina á Illugastöðum í Fnjóskadal. title: Senior Raft Guide & Safety Kayaker / Kayak leiðbeinandi
description: Arctic Rafting is looking for a Senior Raft Guide and Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor for the upcoming summer season of 2027. Our season is May – September, with our high season in the summer time; June – August. There are some operations and preparations to do also before and after, in April and October. In particular, we are looking for someone to come in March, to repair equipment and do admin office work for the river operation, to prepare for the summer. This position will extend to be all year round, working part time over the winter months and taking a long leave (1-3 months). Arctic Rafting has a base camp on the well known tourist circuit of “The Golden Circle” in the southern part of Iceland, in just over an hour drive from Reykjavík capital city. Our operations include family friendly rafting trips on the mighty Hvítá River (class II-III), which is the third longest river in Iceland, originating from Langjökull Glacier. Our base camp has other amenities like a bar, restaurant, sauna and hot tubs, so clients can wind down after an action-packed adventure on the river.The qualities we are looking for is experience with good customer service, and good team work skills. Any added language skills are appreciated, operational skills for safe and high quality river trips, repairing skills for river rafting gear and other equipment, and skills for cooking, cleaning, photography, marketing/office, mechanics and general handy man skills. Job description and responsibilities of a Senior Raft Guide:* Operate safe and entertaining river tours for clients (rafting or kayaking)* Be a team leader and trip lead a group of guides in rafting trips of the size of 100+ clients* Kitchen worker and general work in the restaurant and bar serving clients* Work around the property (repair gear, cleaning, laundry, gardening and handy man jobs)Requirements:* Current WRT (Whitewater Rescue Technician) or similar* Current IRF (International Rafting Federation) certification or similar* Up to date Advanced First Aid training* Minimum 5 seasons of raft guide experience* Good English skills to communicate with clientsExtras, good to have, but not a requirement:* A big bus license to drive the river shuttle (45 seater)* Kitchen and bar experience* Photography skills* Sales / marketing skillsWork arrangements:* We generally have one morning trip and one afternoon trip every day; you either do two trips per day, or one trip and then base work for the rest of the day (cooking, cleaning, repair gear, etc.)* The work days can be anything from 4-12 hours per day, but the normality is generally 8-9 hours* A full time job means 160-170 hours per month, and as the hours vary, the pay is by hourly rates* Normally you would get 2 days off per week, but this can vary to 1-3 days off weeklyHousing and food:* Living arrangements is at an old farm in the countryside 1,5 hour from Reykjavík city, next to the river rafting base / restaurant* Everyone gets their own private room, including shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* We do daily communal dinners and everyone is expected to partake in the cooking and cleaning at the end of the day* We supply breakfast, lunch and dinner; while you are at the raft base for work Rates:* Depending on your skill level and experience the pay would be around 2.500 – 2.900isk per hour* In addition to this we offer free housing and food for your stay during your work periodPlease note that in Iceland we pay around 40% tax, and other fees will be deducted too (union, pension fund etc.)Benefits:* Some great times living in the countryside, being a raft guide for an Icelandic summer season* Private room with shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* Use of base facilities (staff kitchen, hot pots and sauna)* Occasional use of communal work car; we strongly recommend having a valid driver’s license, as public transport in Iceland is quite horrid when you live at an old farm in the middle of nowhere.About the Company:This is one of the oldest adventure activities to do in Iceland, but the first river rafting trip with clients was made here in 1985. Around 1990 they started renovations at the old barn and farm house to make the raft base into what it is today; changing rooms, showers, sauna, hot pots, restaurant, bar and guide facilities; for around 10-12 staff members to live there for the summer season. Our clients are mostly from Iceland, Europe and USA, so the minimal language requirements are good English skills. Owned by a local raft guide and kayaker, and more details can be found on our website: www.arcticrafting.com This video sums up what a normal day in the summer looks like – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQTo apply; please send a CV and cover letter to drumbo@arcticrafting.is before 1st of December 2026Best regards,The Arctic Rafting teamdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.comArctic Rafting leitar að reyndum flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanni (Senior Raft Guide) og öryggiskajakræðara/kajakkennara (Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor) fyrir komandi sumartímabil árið 2027.Starfstímabilið okkar er frá maí til september, en háannatíminn er yfir sumarmánuðina, júní til ágúst. Einnig þarf að sinna ýmsum undirbúnings- og rekstrarverkefnum fyrir og eftir tímabilið, í apríl og október.Við leitum sérstaklega að einstaklingi sem getur hafið störf í mars til að sinna viðgerðum á búnaði og skrifstofu- og stjórnsýsluverkefnum tengdum flúðasiglingarekstrinum, til undirbúnings fyrir sumarið.Starfið mun þróast yfir í heilsársstarf, þar sem unnið verður í hlutastarfi yfir vetrarmánuðina og möguleiki verður á lengra leyfi, í 1–3 mánuði.StarfsumhverfiðArctic Rafting er með bækistöð við hina þekktu ferðamannaleið Gullna hringinn á Suðurlandi, í rúmlega klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík.Starfsemin felur meðal annars í sér fjölskylduvænar flúðasiglingaferðir á hinni mikilfenglegu Hvítá (erfiðleikaflokkur II–III). Hvítá er þriðja lengsta á Íslands og á upptök sín við Langjökul.Á bækistöðinni er einnig bar, veitingastaður, gufubað og heitir pottar þar sem gestir geta slakað á eftir ævintýralega ferð niður ána.Eiginleikar sem við leitum aðVið leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur reynslu af góðri þjónustu við viðskiptavini og býr yfir góðri hæfni í teymisvinnu.Önnur tungumálakunnátta er kostur, sem og færni í að skipuleggja og framkvæma öruggar og vandaðar flúðasiglingaferðir.Einnig er kostur að hafa reynslu af viðgerðum á flúðasiglingabúnaði og öðrum tækjum, matreiðslu, þrifum, ljósmyndun, markaðssetningu, skrifstofustörfum, vélaviðgerðum og almennum viðhaldsverkefnum.Starfslýsing og ábyrgð yfirleiðsögumannsStjórna öruggum og skemmtilegum flúðasiglinga- og kajakferðum fyrir viðskiptavini.Vera leiðtogi teymis og stýra hópi leiðsögumanna í flúðasiglingaferðum með yfir 100 þátttakendum.Vinna í eldhúsi og sinna almennum störfum á veitingastað og bar, þar á meðal þjónustu við gesti.Sinna ýmsum verkefnum á svæðinu, svo sem viðgerðum á búnaði, þrifum, þvotti, garðvinnu og almennu viðhaldi.HæfniskröfurGilt WRT-skírteini (Whitewater Rescue Technician – sérhæfð björgun í straumvatni) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild IRF-réttindi (International Rafting Federation – Alþjóðasamband flúðasiglinga) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild og uppfærð réttindi í ítarlegri skyndihjálp (Advanced First Aid).Að lágmarki fimm tímabils reynsla sem flúðasiglingaleiðsögumaður.Góð enskukunnátta til að eiga samskipti við viðskiptavini.Viðbótarhæfni sem er kostur en ekki skilyrðiÖkuréttindi til að aka stórri rútu (45 farþega) sem notuð er til að flytja gesti til og frá ánni.Reynsla af eldhús- og barstörfum.Hæfni í ljósmyndun.Reynsla af sölu- og markaðsmálum.Vinnutími og starfskjörYfirleitt eru farnar tvær flúðasiglingaferðir á dag, ein að morgni og önnur síðdegis.Starfsmaður fer annaðhvort í tvær ferðir á dag eða eina ferð og sinnir síðan öðrum verkefnum á bækistöðinni, svo sem matreiðslu, þrifum eða viðgerðum á búnaði.Vinnudagar geta verið allt frá 4 upp í 12 klukkustundir, en algengast er að þeir séu um 8–9 klukkustundir.Fullt starf miðast við 160–170 vinnustundir á mánuði. Þar sem vinnustundir eru breytilegar eru laun greidd samkvæmt tímakaupi.Yfirleitt eru tveir frídagar í viku, en þeir geta verið frá einum upp í þrjá eftir aðstæðum.Húsnæði og fæðiStarfsfólk býr á gömlum sveitabæ í um 1,5 klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík, við hliðina á flúðasiglingabækistöðinni og veitingastaðnum.Allir starfsmenn fá sérherbergi en deila sameiginlegri aðstöðu, þar á meðal baðherbergi með sturtu.Sameiginlegur kvöldverður er á hverjum degi og ætlast er til að allir taki þátt í matreiðslu og frágangi í lok dags.Boðið er upp á morgunmat, hádegismat og kvöldmat á meðan starfsfólk er við vinnu á bækistöðinni.LaunTímakaup fer eftir hæfni og reynslu viðkomandi og er á bilinu 2.500–2.900 krónur á klukkustund.Auk launa er boðið upp á ókeypis húsnæði og fæði meðan á starfstímabilinu stendur.Athugið að á Íslandi geta skattar numið um 40% af launum og að önnur gjöld eru einnig dregin frá, svo sem stéttarfélagsgjöld og lífeyrissjóðsiðgjöld.FríðindiEinstakt tækifæri til að upplifa íslenskt sumar í sveitinni og starfa við flúðasiglingar.Sérherbergi með sameiginlegri baðaðstöðu.Aðgangur að aðstöðu á bækistöðinni, þar á meðal starfsmannaeldhúsi, heitum pottum og gufubaði.Stundum er hægt að nýta sameiginlegan starfsmannabíl.Við mælum eindregið með því að umsækjendur hafi gilt ökuskírteini, þar sem almenningssamgöngur á Íslandi eru afar takmarkaðar þegar búið er á gömlum sveitabæ úti í sveit.Um fyrirtækiðFlúðasiglingar eru ein elsta skipulagða ævintýraafþreying sem boðið hefur verið upp á á Íslandi. Fyrsta flúðasiglingaferðin með viðskiptavini á þessu svæði var farin árið 1985.Um 1990 hófst endurnýjun á gamla fjósinu og íbúðarhúsinu á bænum með það að markmiði að útbúa þá aðstöðu sem þar er í dag.Þar er nú að finna búningsklefa, sturtur, gufubað, heita potta, veitingastað, bar og aðstöðu fyrir leiðsögumenn. Á sumrin er aðstaða fyrir um 10–12 starfsmenn til að búa á staðnum.Viðskiptavinir okkar koma að mestu leyti frá Íslandi, Evrópu og Bandaríkjunum og því er góð enskukunnátta lágmarkskrafa.Fyrirtækið er í eigu flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanns og kajakræðara úr heimabyggð.Nánari upplýsingar um fyrirtækið má finna á vefsíðunni:www.arcticrafting.comMyndband sem sýnir dæmigerðan sumardag hjá Arctic Rafting:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQUmsóknir:Áhugasamir eru beðnir um að senda ferilskrá og kynningarbréf á netfangið:drumbo@arcticrafting.isUmsóknarfrestur er til 1. desember 2026.Með bestu kveðju,Starfsfólk Arctic Raftingdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.com

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description: Duties•    Bill Verification & Exception Resolution: Audit logistics, insurance, and related bills to identify discrepancies. Drive timely resolution of exceptions to accelerate receivables recovery, mitigate bad debt risks, and enhance settlement efficiency and client satisfaction. •    Process Optimization & System Enhancement: Diagnose settlement workflow bottlenecks and advocate for system upgrades. Design automated tools to minimize manual intervention, improve accuracy, and support scalable business growth. •    Risk Control & Compliance Oversight: Monitor contract terms, settlement documents, and fund flows to detect compliance risks. Implement proactive mitigation strategies, ensuring adherence to financial policies and regulatory standards to safeguard corporate integrity. •    Cross-Functional Collaboration: Facilitate interdepartmental coordination (business, tech, etc.) to resolve settlement bottlenecks. policies, regulatory standards and internal-control requirements governing receivables and compliance risk mitigation.•    Working knowledge of costing and BOM-based cost tracking for product and project accounting, supporting gross-margin and pricing analysis.Hours of Work: 40 hours per week (Monday to Friday - 9.00am to 6.00pm)Work Location: Remote

title: Census Field Support Officer
description: The Census Field Support Officer (previously known as Census Enumerator) is a key member of the Census 2027 field staff team. As a Census Field Support Officer, you will work in or near your local area. Between 5 April and 9 May, you will be calling to homes to let people know about Census 2027 and to offer help and support. After 9 May, you will follow up with the homes in your area which have not completed a census form.You may be required to engage with local groups in your area to help them to understand the census and what they need to do to complete their census forms, along with other census field staff.You should be physically fit as you will be responsible for between 450-850 homes. In some cases, you may be required to make repeat visits to homes to ensure that the householder is aware of and supported to take part in the census.A mobile phone will be provided with a census field app to show you the map of your area and the list of homes to visit. You will record your visits and other details on the mobile phone app. If a household completes their census online, it will automatically be removed from your visit list.You will report to a Census Field Supervisor who will manage a team of census field support officers. Training will be provided and there will be regular contact and support to help you in your role.Census 2027 will take place between 5 April and 9 May 2027. For the first time, people will be able to choose between completing their census form online or on paper. There will be a five-week period (5 April to 9 May) to complete census forms, rather than one census night. Some 3,850 Census Field Support Officers will work on Census 2027 in every part of Ireland. The Census Field Support Officer job is 18 hours per week (mainly evenings and weekends) and is an eight-week contract from 5 April to 28 May. The rate of pay for the full duration will be over €3,000 plus an allowance. Candidates must be over 18 years of age.

title: Assistant Pharmacy Manager
description: Assistant Pharmacy Manager, Tonlegee road40 hours per weekOur people make the difference. Here at PHX Ireland, we strive to be a place for everyone - where each and every one of us can be our true, authentic selves, every single day.  For us, individuality sparks new ideas, shapes new approaches and brings us powerful new perspectives. It’s the heartbeat of our innovation, creativity, and success. We are founded on values of compassionate care, advice you can trust, speedy service and excellent value for money. The patient and customer are truly at the heart of what we do. The teams that serve our customers are central to our organisation. Our commitment to our staff is to enable them to develop their careers and to have as many opportunities to be the best they can be. We support our team with continuing education, great working conditions, flexibility and good incentives and benefits and a fun loving working environment. If you think you could flourish along side us, please apply.   About PHX Ireland & PHOENIX Group    PHX Ireland Group is Ireland’s leading fully integrated healthcare provider. We deliver health. We are comprised of United Drug, Ireland’s leading pharmaceutical wholesaler and distributor; McCabes Pharmacy, Ireland’s leading community pharmacy chain; and TCP Homecare, innovators in clinical home nursing services and direct to patient delivery solutions. By working together to provide these solutions, PHX Ireland can enable a sustainable healthcare system and support Irish Healthcare. PHX Ireland is part of the PHOENIX group, Europe’s leading healthcare provider. Headquartered in Mannheim, Germany, the PHOENIX group brings together more than 48,000 employees from 29 countries, includes 223 pharmaceutical distribution sites, and more than 3200 owned pharmacies and 17000 partner pharmacies. Every day, the PHOENIX group makes an important contribution to comprehensive and safe healthcare in Europe. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: JOB TITLE: PROCUREMENT DIRECTOR Settore di riferimento: Manifatturiero / Componentistica Elettromeccanica ed Elettronica di Precisione (Audio Professionale) Sede di lavoro: Provincia di Firenze L'Azienda Il nostro cliente è una prestigiosa realtà industriale italiana, quotata in Borsa e leader globale nello sviluppo di componenti tecnologici ad altissime prestazioni per il mercato dell'Audio Professionale (sistemi di amplificazione ed emissione sonora per grandi eventi, stadi e installazioni complesse). Caratterizzata da un forte orientamento all'innovazione e da un network commerciale ed industriale fortemente internazionalizzato (con hub in Europa, Nord America e Asia), l'azienda rappresenta un'eccellenza del Made in Italy nel mondo. Per supportare un piano strutturato e progressivo di passaggio generazionale, siamo alla ricerca di una figura manageriale che affianchi l'attuale Responsabile della funzione per raccoglierne il testimone nel medio periodo. Nota di inclusività: Non è richiesta l'esperienza pregressa nel settore specifico dell'Audio Professionale. Valutiamo con forte interesse candidature provenienti da altri comparti industriali strutturati (es. Automotive, Elettromeccanica, Aerospace, Machinery) in grado di contaminare l'organizzazione con nuove metodologie e visioni evolute del procurement. La Sfida & Il Ruolo Il Procurement Director avrà la responsabilità strategica e operativa di definire le politiche di approvvigionamento globali, garantendo la totale continuità e resilienza della supply chain, l'ottimizzazione dei costi e lo sviluppo del parco fornitori. Trattandosi di un ruolo a forte impronta relazionale e geopolitica, la risorsa dovrà possedere una spiccata capacità di negoziazione interculturale e la disponibilità a effettuare trasferte internazionali, talvolta in aree logisticamente complesse o remote per lo scouting diretto delle fonti di fornitura. Principali Responsabilità Strategia di Sourcing: Definire e implementare le strategie di acquisto di materie prime, semilavorati e componenti tecnici in linea con i piani di crescita e i target di marginalità aziendali. Gestione del Rischio Supply Chain: Monitorare i mercati internazionali e pianificare strategie di mitigazione del rischio legati alle fluttuazioni dei prezzi e alle complessità logistiche/geopolitiche. Scouting & Network Globale: Condurre attività di scouting internazionale per diversificare e consolidare il portafoglio fornitori strategici (commodity metalliche, componenti elettronici e plastici). title: Database and network professionals
description: Per importante struttura sanitaria, stiamo cercando un/una: Senior IT Systems Specialist/Responsabile IT La risorsa sarà responsabile presidio ICT interno della sede: garantirà continuità operativa e sicurezza dei servizi IT, gestendo e coordinando in prima persona le attività tecniche e coordinando i fornitori, contribuendo anche a dare un indirizzo su priorità e roadmap locale in raccordo con Direzione e IT di gruppo. Responsabilità Presidio operativo IT di sede: gestione e supporto su postazioni, rete/Wi-Fi, stampanti/periferiche, sale e ambulatori; troubleshooting di 1°/2° livello, gestione ticket ed escalation. Sistemi informativi sanitari: configurazione, manutenzione e monitoraggio di applicativi (es. cartella clinica elettronica, prenotazioni/CUP, telemedicina e integrazioni correlate). Vendor management: punto di contatto per fornitori IT (assistenza applicativa/infrastrutturale), pianificazione interventi, verifica deliverable e qualità del servizio (SLA/KPI), escalation. Continuità di servizio: monitoraggio servizi critici, backup/restore, gestione incident e piani di ripristino in coordinamento con IT centrale. Sicurezza e compliance: applicazione delle policy e supporto a audit/controlli (GDPR, ISO 27001, NIS2 e linee guida interne), gestione accessi/utenze e aggiornamenti in raccordo con il gruppo. Indirizzo e miglioramento: raccolta esigenze dei reparti, proposta di priorità e interventi (quick win + strutturali), ottimizzazione dei flussi digitali clinico-amministrativi, supporto al change e formazione utenti. Requisiti Esperienza in ruoli IT con responsabilità end-to-end su sede/plant o contesti regolati; preferibile esposizione a healthcare. Conoscenza delle principali infrastrutture ICT e networking (es. Fortinet/Cisco/Aruba/Watchguard o equivalenti). Conoscenza di sistemi di Virtualizzazione e backup (es. VMware/Proxmox, Veeam o equivalenti). Conoscenza database (SQL e principali RDBMS: Oracle/PostgreSQL, ecc.) a livello operativo. Autonomia, capacità di prioritizzazione, comunicazione efficace con utenti e Direzione; gestione di più attività in parallelo. Plus Esperienza con sistemi sanitari (es. H2O, Dedalus, TuoTempo o equivalenti) e integrazioni. Certificazioni (Microsoft, VMware, Fortinet, ITIL o simili). Esperienza su telemedicina e/o iniziative di cybersecurity in sanità. Si offre inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato e RAL fino a 60.000€ Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. title: Principal System Applications Engineer Solid State Transformer  (SST) (f/m/div) (Ingenieur/in - Mikroelektronik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. Turning customer whispers into industry-shaking solutions... ready to amplify the future?As a Principal System Applications Engineer Solid State Transformer (SST) on our Customer Collaboration and Technical Marketing team work hand-in-hand with our customers, enabling them to transform our products into cutting-edge designs, all while building long-lasting partnerships that thrive on success.Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Engage with leading customers to understand SST architectures, requirements, and technical challenges, translating them into semiconductor and subsystem solutions.- Develop and validate application solutions through simulation, prototyping, measurements, benchmarking, and troubleshooting.- Create technical proof points using PoCs, demonstrators, and experimental validation, including collaboration with external partners.- Convert engineering results into customer-ready technical materials, such as design recommendations, BOM guidance, simulation models, and training content. - Enable Field Application Engineers (FAEs) and regional teams through technical training, workshops, and support for complex customer engagements.- Support strategic customer projects and design-ins, working with customers and internal experts to solve system-level application challenges.Your profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field, combined with 6+ years of industry experience in power electronics, power conversion, or application engineering.- Possess strong expertise in power converter topologies and power semiconductor technologies, with experience in Solid-State Transformers (SSTs), medium-voltage systems, modular converters, or multilevel converters considered a plus.- Demonstrate a broad system-level understanding of gate driving, control, protection, sensing, magnetics, thermal management, and reliability.- Apply hands-on experience in simulation, hardware development, commissioning, measurement, and troubleshooting to develop and validate engineering solutions.- Translate system requirements into practical semiconductor and subsystem recommendations, balancing technical performance and application needs.- Thrive in global, cross-functional environments, showing strong ownership, collaboration, and the ability to influence and drive topics independently across regions, divisions, customers, and external partners.Salary pay information:AustriaAt Infineon in Villach you shape the technologies of tomorrow and work in an international environment with more than 4.700 colleagues from over 70 nations. Your personal contribution will be valued and appreciated as the cornerstones of our success. And all that in beautiful surroundings which guarantee a high quality of life.The City of Villach is located in the center of Carinthia, Austria’s southernmost province, in close proximity to the Italian and Slovenian border. Due to its particular geographic location and the outstanding natural beauty of the region, Villach and the whole province of Carinthia have for generations been popular holiday destinations for people from all over the world. Living in Austria also has many social, health-care-related and economic perks. The country’s social and health care system is among the best in the world and for decades numerous international surveys have singled out Austria as a particularly safe and wealthy country with a high quality of life. Villach benefits from its status as a “small town”, offering everyday living at affordable prices in an outstanding setting.We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group I,J* (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). title: Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) - HRC1792713 (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.Driving continuous improvement - ready to make quality a culture?As a Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) in our Quality & Excellence team uncover the root causes behind every single error, drive transformational improvements, and implement forward-thinking solutions to ensure our products exceed the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Act as the technical lead and methodological expert for Burn-in (BI), including steering BI decisions, driving continuous improvements, and serving as the primary interface to technology and product development as well as statistics teams- Provide teaching, coaching, and knowledge transfer on Burn-in topics to cross-functional teams, ensuring a consistent and high-quality understanding of BI methodologies across the organization- Support Design for Stress (DfS) sustaining activities, including the management and resolution of DfS Jira Tickets in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders- Serve as the 1st level of support for internal customer inquiries, with a particular focus on** Automotive Governance**, ensuring timely and solution-oriented responses- Drive long-term, strategically important tasks that require sustained attention, ensuring that critical but non-urgent topics receive appropriate prioritization and follow-through- Collaborate closely with Front-End (FE), Back-End (BE) and product development teams, contributing expert knowledge on failure mechanisms, defects, design and test conditions to support informed quality decisions- Lead customer communications about early topics- Contribute to the continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems (QMS), processes, methods, and tools along the entire supply chain, with a strong automotive quality mindsetYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - A degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field- At least 6 years of professional work experience in semiconductor manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality management along the supply chain, Front-End and Back-End processes, and reliability testing- Expert-level knowledge in Burn-in methodologies, including deep understanding of physical failure mechanisms, defect analysis, Fault Analysis (FA), and test conditions relevant to semiconductor devices- Proven experience as a technical lead in a cross-functional environment, with the ability to drive decisions, align stakeholders, and manage Design for Stress (DfS) activities effectively- Solid understanding of wafer manufacturing process, foundational skills in data analysis, and familiarity with chip design, test engineering and product development processes- Proficiency in digital collaboration tools such as Confluence, Jira, and Intranet platforms- Show a strong automotive quality mindset and knowledge about automotive requirements- Outstanding interpersonal skills and a genuine service provider attitude, with demonstrated ability to coach, teach, and inspire colleagues while fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture- Fluent English (written and spoken); German is a plusPlease send us your CV in EnglishPlease note that:- Subject to meeting all job requirements, belonging to protected categories under Law 68/69 will be considered a preferential requirementAdditional information by locationAustriaWe offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H,I (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.Salary pay information:In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.LocationIndicative salary rangePadova, Italy*€52,000 – €71,500*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. Employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package, which may include further compensation and benefit elements depending on local regulations and company policies.#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/)  and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/)  at Infineon.HRC1792713

title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Grafton Office* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per importante azienda cliente ricerchiamo: Buying Planner La risorsa, inserita all'interno dell'Ufficio Buying e in collaborazione con i Buyer e la Direzione Commerciale, supporterà le attività di pianificazione, monitoraggio e gestione operativa degli ordini, contribuendo all'ottimizzazione della disponibilità del prodotto, della rotazione delle scorte e della marginalità. Nello specifico, la figura inserita si occuperà di: Monitorare le performance di vendita dei prodotti, analizzando sell-in, sell-out, stock, rotazioni, stock coverage e marginalità per categoria, brand, linea e punto vendita, individuando trend, criticità e opportunità commerciali; Supportare la pianificazione degli assortimenti e dei fabbisogni di prodotto per insegna, categoria, stagione e canale distributivo, sulla base dei dati storici, previsionali e degli obiettivi commerciali; Supportare il team Buying nella definizione dei quantitativi di acquisto e nella costruzione dell'assortimento; Monitorare il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ingresso in assortimento fino alla fase di fine stagione, individuando eventuali criticità e opportunità di intervento; Analizzare le giacenze e individuare tempestivamente situazioni di overstock, understock e slow moving, supportando la definizione delle relative azioni correttive; Supportare il team Buying, in collaborazione con Planning & Allocation, nell'individuazione delle esigenze di riassortimento e redistribuzione del prodotto; Monitorare l'andamento dei budget di acquisto e degli obiettivi economici assegnati alle diverse categorie merceologiche, segnalando eventuali scostamenti; Gestire operativamente l'inserimento, l'emissione e l'aggiornamento degli ordini di acquisto a sistema, assicurando la correttezza delle informazioni relative a prodotti, quantità, prezzi e condizioni concordate; Monitorare l'avanzamento degli ordini, verificando conferme d'ordine, variazioni, cancellazioni ed eventuali anomalie e interfacciandosi con i fornitori per gli aspetti operativi; Presidiare il follow-up delle consegne e il rispetto delle tempistiche previste, segnalando tempestivamente eventuali ritardi o scostamenti rispetto alla pianificazione e garantendo l'allineamento tra piano di acquisto, ordini emessi e merce in consegna; Predisporre e mantenere aggiornata la reportistica relativa a ordini, budget impegnato, consegne, stock e performance di prodotto, fornendo analisi a supporto dell'Ufficio Buying e della Direzione Commerciale. Requisiti richiesti: Laurea in discipline economiche, statistiche, gestionali, moda o affini. Esperienza pregressa di almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli di Buying Planning, Merchandise Planning, Buying, Merchandising o Product Management, preferibilmente nel settore fashion retail. Conoscenza delle logiche di assortimento, pianificazione e gestione dello stock nel settore retail. Spiccata capacità di analisi e interpretazione dei dati. Utilizzo avanzato di Excel; gradita la conoscenza di strumenti di Business Intelligence. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il profilo: approccio analitico e commerciale, capacità di lettura delle performance di prodotto, ottime capacità organizzative e di pianificazione, precisione, problem solving, Sede di lavoro: Palermo, Orari: Lun-Ven 8:30 - 13:00 / 14:30 - 18:00 CCNL Commercio Range Retributivo previsto: € 23.300 - € 27.000. Il posizionamento all'interno della fascia sarà determinato sulla base delle competenze e dell'esperienza professionale coerenti con i requisiti della posizione. *Grafton Office è una specializzazione di Gi Group Spa autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut.Min. 26/11/2004 PROT. 1101 - SG). description: Per un'azienda italiana del settore moda e accessori, con una forte presenza internazionale e una distribuzione omnicanale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Head of E-Commerce & Customer Care. Sarà responsabile di accelerare le performance online, rafforzare il valore del brand, aumentare il coinvolgimento dei clienti e offrire un'esperienza omnicanale fluida. Il profilo ideale unisce visione strategica, senso commerciale ed eccellenza operativa, oltre a una forte passione per il lusso, la moda e la customer experience. Missione Sviluppare piani promozionali e strategici online e offline, in collaborazione con i dipartimenti Brand, Commerciale, Comunicazione, Visual e Merchandising e in accordo con il COO.
