Attività principali Sviluppare e implementare strategie promozionali e di marketing online e offline a supporto degli obiettivi aziendali. Guidare, coordinare e supportare i team E-Commerce, CRM e Customer Care. Monitorare le performance di vendita, analizzare i principali indicatori e massimizzare il fatturato e la redditività dell'E-Commerce. Collaborare con i team IT per garantire una corretta integrazione dei sistemi e il miglioramento continuo della piattaforma. Individuare opportunità per migliorare il customer journey e ottimizzare l'esperienza complessiva degli utenti. Analizzare i dati aziendali e dei clienti per definire piani strategici di crescita e ricavare indicazioni operative. Coordinare e gestire i rapporti con partner esterni e agenzie che supportano le attività di E-Commerce, CRM e Customer Care. Monitorare le tendenze di mercato, i comportamenti dei clienti e le iniziative dei concorrenti per individuare nuove opportunità di business. Garantire l'allineamento tra obiettivi commerciali, posizionamento del brand ed esperienza del cliente in tutti i punti di contatto. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di senior leadership nell'E-Commerce, maturata nei settori moda, lusso, lifestyle. Forte orientamento commerciale e comprovata capacità di generare crescita dei ricavi online. Approfondita competenza in E-Commerce, CRM, gestione del ciclo di vita del cliente e analisi delle performance digitali. Ottime capacità di leadership e gestione degli stakeholder. Spiccate capacità analitiche e attitudine a trasformare dati complessi in decisioni strategiche. Passione per l'innovazione digitale, la customer experience e lo sviluppo del brand. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese. Throughout the year, the successful candidate will accompany the family to their residences in Kitzbühel (Austria), Florence (Italy), Southampton (England), New York (USA) and Casa de Campo (Dominican Republic).Key Responsibilities:- Planning and preparing high-quality meals, predominantly vegetarian and plant-based, using fresh organic ingredients- Independently organizing and managing a high-end private household- Overseeing housekeeping, cleaning and maintenance of the residences- Coordinating external service providers and additional household staff- Monitoring and overseeing household technical systems and smart home technology- Managing purchasing, stock control and general household logistics- Occasional driving duties and airport transfers, as well as assistance with travel arrangementsCandidate Profile:- Several years of professional experience in high-end private households, luxury hotels or fine-dining establishments- Extensive culinary knowledge and experience in high-end cuisine- Good command of English and confident IT skills (MS Office, Google Docs)- Technical aptitude and practical DIY skills- Valid driving license and EU passport issued by a Schengen Area member state- Independent, well-organized and service-oriented approach to work- High standards of quality, cleanliness and attention to detail- Absolute discretion, loyalty and reliability- Non-smokerWhat Is Offered:- Long-term position with a high degree of responsibility and autonomy- Attractive remuneration package- Two months of annual leave (one month each in spring and autumn)- Support from additional household staff and external service providersThe position is available by mutual agreement, with remuneration commensurate with the demanding nature and responsibilities of the role.Referenz-Nr.: A26/9876 INT

title: tecnico meccanico
description: Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 is Gi Group's specialist division—Italy's leading multinational employment company—dedicated to enhancing candidates' experience, skills and potential in the mechanical, mechatronic and electromechanical fields. For FERRERO ARDENNES, a global leader in the confectionery industry, we are recruiting: MECHANICAL MAINTENANCE TECHNICIANS FOR FERRERO - BELGIUM At Ferrero's ARLON site you will find: Highly automated production lines and latest-generation Industry 4.0 technologies A solid, structured and merit-based organization that values strategic maintenance skills An international environment with many colleagues who have relocated from Italy and from all over the world What you will do The selected candidate will join the maintenance team (about 90 people) and will be responsible for routine, extraordinary, preventive/predictive and breakdown maintenance on automated systems within the Arlon production site. Requirements Strong technical/mechanical background Fault diagnosis skills Experience in preventive/predictive and breakdown maintenance in the mechanical, pneumatic and hydraulic fields Ability to replace components and manage format changeovers Ability to identify tolerances and dimensions, and to read/interpret mechanical and pneumatic drawings A strong motivation to relocate and to build a long-term professional and personal project abroad will complete the profile. Offer Gross annual salary between €45,000 and €60,000 Company-provided accommodation for the first two months Relocation allowance of €8,000 gross Electronic meal vouchers with a nominal value of €10 per working day, with €8.91 paid by the company and €1.09 paid by the employee 13.92 monthly payments Belgian Collective Labour Agreement CCT118 Job grade: skilled maintenance worker Supplementary health insurance (DKV) for the employee, spouse/partner and dependent children up to 25 years old Electronic gift voucher worth €40 net The client company will also cover the costs of a French language course. title: Principal System Applications Engineer Solid State Transformer  (SST) (f/m/div) (Ingenieur/in - Mikroelektronik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. Turning customer whispers into industry-shaking solutions... ready to amplify the future?As a Principal System Applications Engineer Solid State Transformer (SST) on our Customer Collaboration and Technical Marketing team work hand-in-hand with our customers, enabling them to transform our products into cutting-edge designs, all while building long-lasting partnerships that thrive on success.Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Engage with leading customers to understand SST architectures, requirements, and technical challenges, translating them into semiconductor and subsystem solutions.- Develop and validate application solutions through simulation, prototyping, measurements, benchmarking, and troubleshooting.- Create technical proof points using PoCs, demonstrators, and experimental validation, including collaboration with external partners.- Convert engineering results into customer-ready technical materials, such as design recommendations, BOM guidance, simulation models, and training content. - Enable Field Application Engineers (FAEs) and regional teams through technical training, workshops, and support for complex customer engagements.- Support strategic customer projects and design-ins, working with customers and internal experts to solve system-level application challenges.Your profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field, combined with 6+ years of industry experience in power electronics, power conversion, or application engineering.- Possess strong expertise in power converter topologies and power semiconductor technologies, with experience in Solid-State Transformers (SSTs), medium-voltage systems, modular converters, or multilevel converters considered a plus.- Demonstrate a broad system-level understanding of gate driving, control, protection, sensing, magnetics, thermal management, and reliability.- Apply hands-on experience in simulation, hardware development, commissioning, measurement, and troubleshooting to develop and validate engineering solutions.- Translate system requirements into practical semiconductor and subsystem recommendations, balancing technical performance and application needs.- Thrive in global, cross-functional environments, showing strong ownership, collaboration, and the ability to influence and drive topics independently across regions, divisions, customers, and external partners.Salary pay information:AustriaAt Infineon in Villach you shape the technologies of tomorrow and work in an international environment with more than 4.700 colleagues from over 70 nations. Your personal contribution will be valued and appreciated as the cornerstones of our success. And all that in beautiful surroundings which guarantee a high quality of life.The City of Villach is located in the center of Carinthia, Austria’s southernmost province, in close proximity to the Italian and Slovenian border. Due to its particular geographic location and the outstanding natural beauty of the region, Villach and the whole province of Carinthia have for generations been popular holiday destinations for people from all over the world. Living in Austria also has many social, health-care-related and economic perks. The country’s social and health care system is among the best in the world and for decades numerous international surveys have singled out Austria as a particularly safe and wealthy country with a high quality of life. Villach benefits from its status as a “small town”, offering everyday living at affordable prices in an outstanding setting.We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group I,J* (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.ItalyLocationIndicative salary rangeMilan, Italy*€63360 – €87120*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. Employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package, which may include further compensation and benefit elements depending on local regulations and company policies.#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

title: dirigente delle risorse umane
description: Direttore Generale Azienda di servizi SW & HW - Information Technology | Piccola Impresa Wyser ricerca un Direttore Generale per una PI (piccola impresa) italiana a proprietà imprenditoriale, attiva nell'erogazione di servizi SW&HW ICT a imprese ed enti pubblici. L'azienda offre soluzioni SW & HW per infrastrutture e reti, cloud, cybersecurity e assistenza IT, integrate con fornitura e noleggio di tecnologie hardware e software. Si distingue per la relazione continuativa con i clienti e per un approccio da boutique orientato alla qualità del servizio. Il ruolo Il Direttore Generale affiancherà la proprietà nella definizione e nell'attuazione della strategia aziendale, assumendo la responsabilità del coordinamento complessivo delle attività e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi concordati. Contribuirà al rafforzamento dell'organizzazione e all'evoluzione dell'offerta, con attenzione alla redditività, all'innovazione tecnologica e allo sviluppo delle persone. Principali responsabilità Definire con la proprietà il piano di sviluppo aziendale e tradurlo in obiettivi, budget e priorità operative, monitorandone l'attuazione e proponendo eventuali azioni correttive. Migliorare il modello organizzativo, i processi e gli strumenti di pianificazione e controllo, introducendo responsabilità chiare e indicatori di performance a supporto delle decisioni. Presidiare i risultati economici e gestionali, in collaborazione con la funzione amministrativa, attraverso l'analisi di ricavi, costi, marginalità di progetti e servizi, investimenti e impiego delle risorse. Coordinare le funzioni commerciali, tecniche e operative, assicurando coerenza tra obiettivi di vendita, capacità di erogazione e qualità del servizio al cliente. Sviluppare il business consolidando le relazioni con i clienti strategici, individuando nuove opportunità e favorendo una maggiore integrazione dell'offerta per imprese ed enti pubblici. Guidare l'evoluzione del portafoglio di soluzioni e servizi, valutando tecnologie emergenti e applicazioni dell'intelligenza artificiale in funzione delle esigenze del mercato e del ritorno economico. Valorizzare e sviluppare le competenze dei collaboratori, promuovendo collaborazione tra team, responsabilizzazione e condivisione delle conoscenze. Gestire e sviluppare le relazioni con vendor e partner strategici, collaborando con le funzioni competenti al presidio della qualità, della sicurezza delle informazioni e della compliance. Requisiti e competenze Esperienza in ruoli di direzione generale, direzione di business unit o responsabilità manageriale trasversale nel settore dei servizi, preferibilmente presso system integrator o provider di servizi IT, in alternativa altri servizi B2B es. Digital, TLC... Responsabilità maturata nella gestione di risultati economici, budget e team, con capacità di integrare visione strategica ed esecuzione operativa. Conoscenza del mercato ICT e dei modelli di business legati a progetti, servizi ricorrenti e soluzioni tecnologiche; capacità di valutarne marginalità, complessità operativa e potenziale di sviluppo. Preparazione tecnologica adeguata a confrontarsi con gli specialisti su infrastrutture, networking, cloud e cybersecurity e a orientare le scelte di offerta e investimento. Esperienza nel miglioramento di processi e organizzazione, con capacità di introdurre metodi e strumenti gestionali proporzionati alle esigenze di una piccola impresa. Capacità di costruire un rapporto di fiducia con la proprietà, condividere le priorità e rendicontare con chiarezza risultati, criticità e proposte. Costituiranno elementi preferenziali l'esperienza in contesti imprenditoriali o familiari e la partecipazione a percorsi di evoluzione manageriale. Saranno valorizzate anche la conoscenza del mercato pubblico e dei modelli di noleggio tecnologico. La ricerca è aperta anche a figure provenienti da ruoli di direzione Sales & Delivery, Operations o Commerciale, purché abbiano maturato responsabilità effettive su organizzazione, persone e risultati economici, oltre allo sviluppo delle vendite. Lo stile manageriale Cerchiamo una persona autorevole e concreta, capace di ascoltare, comprendere il contesto e accompagnare il cambiamento in modo costruttivo. Saranno centrali la capacità di coinvolgere collaboratori esperti, prendere decisioni e tradurre le opportunità tecnologiche in iniziative sostenibili per il business. L'opportunità professionale Il ruolo offre la possibilità di contribuire direttamente alla direzione e all'evoluzione di una piccola impresa ICT, lavorando a stretto contatto con la proprietà e incidendo sulle scelte organizzative, commerciali e tecnologiche. Il progetto valorizza una figura manageriale capace di coniugare sviluppo del business, qualità del servizio e continuità delle relazioni con clienti e collaboratori. title: Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) - HRC1792713 (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.Driving continuous improvement - ready to make quality a culture?As a Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) in our Quality & Excellence team uncover the root causes behind every single error, drive transformational improvements, and implement forward-thinking solutions to ensure our products exceed the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Act as the technical lead and methodological expert for Burn-in (BI), including steering BI decisions, driving continuous improvements, and serving as the primary interface to technology and product development as well as statistics teams- Provide teaching, coaching, and knowledge transfer on Burn-in topics to cross-functional teams, ensuring a consistent and high-quality understanding of BI methodologies across the organization- Support Design for Stress (DfS) sustaining activities, including the management and resolution of DfS Jira Tickets in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders- Serve as the 1st level of support for internal customer inquiries, with a particular focus on** Automotive Governance**, ensuring timely and solution-oriented responses- Drive long-term, strategically important tasks that require sustained attention, ensuring that critical but non-urgent topics receive appropriate prioritization and follow-through- Collaborate closely with Front-End (FE), Back-End (BE) and product development teams, contributing expert knowledge on failure mechanisms, defects, design and test conditions to support informed quality decisions- Lead customer communications about early topics- Contribute to the continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems (QMS), processes, methods, and tools along the entire supply chain, with a strong automotive quality mindsetYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - A degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field- At least 6 years of professional work experience in semiconductor manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality management along the supply chain, Front-End and Back-End processes, and reliability testing- Expert-level knowledge in Burn-in methodologies, including deep understanding of physical failure mechanisms, defect analysis, Fault Analysis (FA), and test conditions relevant to semiconductor devices- Proven experience as a technical lead in a cross-functional environment, with the ability to drive decisions, align stakeholders, and manage Design for Stress (DfS) activities effectively- Solid understanding of wafer manufacturing process, foundational skills in data analysis, and familiarity with chip design, test engineering and product development processes- Proficiency in digital collaboration tools such as Confluence, Jira, and Intranet platforms- Show a strong automotive quality mindset and knowledge about automotive requirements- Outstanding interpersonal skills and a genuine service provider attitude, with demonstrated ability to coach, teach, and inspire colleagues while fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture- Fluent English (written and spoken); German is a plusPlease send us your CV in EnglishPlease note that:- Subject to meeting all job requirements, belonging to protected categories under Law 68/69 will be considered a preferential requirementAdditional information by locationAustriaWe offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H,I (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.Salary pay information:In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.LocationIndicative salary rangePadova, Italy*€52,000 – €71,500*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. Employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package, which may include further compensation and benefit elements depending on local regulations and company policies.#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/)  and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/)  at Infineon.HRC1792713

title: direttore dei sistemi informatici/direttrice dei sistemi informatici
description: Per conto di una realtà strutturata operante nel settore chimico-farmaceutico, inserita in una fase di trasformazione digitale e di rafforzamento dei presidi di governance, sicurezza e standardizzazione a livello di Gruppo, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Chief Technology Officer La posizione si colloca a diretto riporto del CIO e rappresenta un ruolo 'ponte' tra l'operatività quotidiana e la definizione/adozione di policy, processi e controlli, con focus particolare sulla gestione delle sussidiarie estere e sul governo dei fornitori. Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Contribuire alla roadmap tecnologica insieme al CIO: priorità di investimento, architetture target, standard, piani di miglioramento e misurazione dell'avanzamento. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. Possibili trasferte presso sedi del Gruppo in Italia e all'estero in funzione dei progetti. Inquadramento Contratto a tempo indeterminato, livello Quadro. RAL indicativa 70-80k + bonus variabile 10% Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Il nostro Cliente è un importante gruppo industriale italiano, leader nella manifattura per il settore food & beverage, con presenza internazionale e un percorso di sviluppo fondato su innovazione, investimenti e solidità operativa. Per potenziamento della funzione Acquisti tecnici a supporto dei plant, ricerchiamo un/una: Industrial Sr Buyer / Technical Procurement (CAPEX & MRO). La risorsa, riportando al Purchasing Manager, opererà trasversalmente sugli stabilimenti italiani con impatto diretto su continuità produttiva, governance della spesa tecnica e performance dei fornitori. Collaborerà quotidianamente con Engineering, Manutenzione e Plant Management, oltre che con Qualità/HSE, Finance e Legal. Gestirà relazioni con fornitori italiani e internazionali (OEM, integratori, service provider) e, per investimenti o accordi quadro rilevanti, supporterà l'escalation verso General Management e Proprietà. È possibile un contributo su iniziative corporate di standardizzazione/razionalizzazione con estensione internazionale. Principali responsabilità: Gestione end-to-end del sourcing su CAPEX, servizi tecnici e MRO: dal fabbisogno alla contrattualizzazione Impostazione e conduzione di RFQ/RFP e gare, con comparativi tecnico-economici e analisi TCO Negoziazione di condizioni commerciali e contratti (garanzie, penali, tempi di consegna, collaudi/accettazioni, ricambi e service) Definizione e gestione di accordi quadro e contratti di service con SLA/KPI, aumentando la copertura contrattuale della spesa ricorrente Vendor management: qualifica, monitoraggio performance, gestione criticità/claim, mitigazione rischi (lead time, single source, continuità assistenza) Supporto a Engineering/Manutenzione su standardizzazione, ricambistica critica e iniziative di miglioramento Competenze tecniche richieste: Diploma tecnico (Perito Meccanico/Meccatronico) e/o Laurea in Ingegneria (preferenza Meccanica/Meccatronica/Industriale) Esperienza indicativa 5-10+ anni in acquisti tecnico-industriali in contesti manifatturieri strutturati Esposizione concreta a CAPEX e contrattualistica service, oltre a categorie MRO (ricambi, consumabili, manutenzioni) Familiarità con tendering strutturato, logiche TCO e disciplina di processo Buona padronanza di ERP/strumenti di procurement Inglese fluente per negoziazione e gestione fornitori internazionali Competenze manageriali e soft skills: Negoziazione evoluta e capacità di gestire trade-off costo/qualità/rischio/continuità Autorevolezza con stakeholder tecnici, forte orientamento all'execution e gestione priorità in contesto produttivo Comunicazione sintetica e capacità di escalation strutturata Approccio data-driven, rigore e affidabilità Sede di lavoro: Italia, area Emilia-Romagna, con trasferte prevalentemente nazionali e, in funzione dei progetti, internazionali. Attività prevalentemente on site. Offerta: inserimento a tempo indeterminato. Package indicativo: RAL €45.000-€55.000 + MBO ~10%. title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.

Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt. Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Rahoitusasiantuntija
description: **Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntija: vie yrityksen rahoitushanke itse alusta loppuun****Jokainen yritys ansaitsee rahoituksen, joka on rakennettu sen omaan tilanteeseen ja hankkeeseen.** Siihen tarvitaan ihminen, joka ymmärtää yrityksen tilanteen, ja työkalu, joka tekee valmistelusta nopeaa ja perusteltua.FSG Financial Services Group hakee **itsenäisiä yrittäjiä Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijoiksi**. Olemme rakentaneet uuden palvelumallin ja työkalun, jonka avulla et vain ohjaa asiakasta eteenpäin. **Viet rahoitushankkeen itse ensimmäisestä keskustelusta loppuun saakka.****Trusty Finance Broker** tuo asiakastyön, rahoitusanalyysin ja rahoittajille valmisteltavan aineiston samaan työympäristöön. Sinulle se tarkoittaa **vähemmän rutiinia ja enemmän aikaa asiakkaalle**. Voit hoitaa useampia rahoitushankkeita laadusta tinkimättä.**Trusty Finance Broker muuttaa rahoitusasiantuntijan arjen**Hyvä asiakaskeskustelu on vasta alku. Sen jälkeen yrityksen tilanne pitää jäsentää, rahoituksen perusteet arvioida ja aineisto valmistella. Trusty Finance Broker vie tämän työn kanssasi järjestelmällisesti maaliin.- **Asiakastyötila pitää kokonaisuuden käsissäsi.** Asiakkaat, rahoitushankkeet, sovitut asiat ja seuraavat askeleet ovat yhdessä näkymässä. Näet heti, missä kukin hanke on ja mitä tänään kannattaa tehdä. - **Trusty AI-Engine laskee, sinä tarkistat.** Se yhdistää sääntöpohjaisen laskennan ja tekoälyn. Se laskee tilinpäätöksistä ja tapaamistiedoista, millainen rahoitus hankkeelle sopii ja mihin takaisinmaksu perustuu. - **Asiakasraportti tekee tuloksista ymmärrettäviä.** Asiakas saa raportin päätöksenteon tueksi, ja sinä saat pohjan keskustelulle rahoituksen vaihtoehdoista. - **Rahoittajapaketti kokoaa valmistellun aineiston.** Siitä näkyy, mitä yritys aikoo toteuttaa ja miksi rahoitus kannattaa. Trusty Finance toimittaa sen niille rahoittajille, joille hanke sopii. - **Apua saat suoraan työympäristöstä.** Vaativassa tilanteessa pyydät FSG Financial Services Groupin tukea Ilmoita FSG:lle -toiminnolla. **Sinä tunnet asiakkaan, ja työkalu hoitaa laskennan, dokumentoinnin ja aineiston kokoamisen.** Yritys valitsee saamistaan rahoitustarjouksista itselleen parhaan.**FSG Trusty Finance Akatemia auttaa sinut alkuun ja pidemmälle****Rahoitusalan taustaa ei tarvita aloittamiseen.** Trusty Finance Brokeriin on rakennettu koulutusympäristö, FSG Trusty Finance Akatemia. Se opastaa työympäristön peruskäytöstä aina vaativiin yritysrahoituksen tilanteisiin.Opiskelet omaan tahtiisi, harjoittelet käytännön tilanteita ja osoitat osaamisesi osaamiskokeilla. Etenemisestä saat osaamismerkkejä. **Harjoituksia voit uusia rajattomasti.****Mitä teet Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijana?**- hankit yritysasiakkaita ja avaat keskustelun yrittäjien kanssa heidän hankkeistaan - kartoitat rahoitustarpeen ja kokoat tilinpäätös- ja tapaamistiedot - tarkistat rahoitusanalyysin ja käyt Asiakasraportin läpi asiakkaan kanssa - valmistelet Rahoittajapaketin ja huolehdit sovituista jatkotoimista - pidät asiakkaan ajan tasalla hankkeen loppuun saakka **Roolin ydin ei ole tuotteiden myynti.** Ymmärrät asiakkaan tilanteen ja rakennat sille oikean rahoitusratkaisun. **Trusty Finance on yritykselle maksuton**, mikä madaltaa kynnystä aloittaa keskustelu.**Kenelle tehtävä sopii?**Voit tulla esimerkiksi B2B-myynnin, yritysasiakastyön, pankin, rahoituksen tai taloushallinnon parista. Kokemus yrittäjien kanssa toimimisesta antaa hyvän pohjan, mutta **tärkeintä on oikea ote**: kuuntelet asiakasta, haluat oppia ja viet sovitut asiat loppuun.Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos tartut oma-aloitteisesti uusiin asiakaskeskusteluihin, työskentelet huolellisesti ja haluat rakentaa omaa liiketoimintaasi pitkäjänteisesti.**Yhteistyömalli: toimit itsenäisenä yrittäjänä**Kyseessä on **yrittäjämalli, ei työsuhde**. Voit toimia oman yrityksen kautta tai kevytyrittäjänä, tai voit perustaa yrityksen aloituksen yhteydessä. **Yhteistyö edellyttää Y-tunnusta.** Voit hakea myös, jos olet valmis hankkimaan sen ennen aloittamista.**Ansainta perustuu toteutuneisiin rahoituksiin**Ansaitset provisiota toteutuneista rahoituksista. Aktiivisella tekemisellä ansaintatavoite on **noin 2 000–10 000 euroa kuukaudessa**, ja kokeneilla tekijöillä **yli 10 000 euroa kuukaudessa**. **Palkkiokattoa ei ole.**Kyse on yrittäjän provisiotulosta, ei kiinteästä palkasta eikä taatusta ansiosta. Ansainta riippuu toteutuneista rahoituksista, ja käteen jäävään tuloon vaikuttavat omat yrityskulut ja verot.**Mitä tarjoamme?**- **Trusty Finance Broker** -työympäristön koko asiakastyöhön - **FSG Trusty Finance Akatemian**, jossa osaamisesi kasvaa vaihe vaiheelta - **laajan suomalaisten ja pohjoismaisten rahoittajien verkoston** - oman trustyfinance.fi-sähköpostiosoitteen - perehdytyksen ja tuen perustajatiimiltä - mahdollisuuden edetä vaativampiin asiakassuhteisiin ja suurempiin rahoitushankkeisiin FSG Financial Services Groupin perustajatiimillä on yhteensä **yli 95 vuotta kokemusta** rahoituksesta, varainhoidosta ja teknologiasta. Tämä kokemus on tukenasi alusta alkaen.**Mitä tarvitset aloittaaksesi?**- oman tietokoneen, puhelimen ja internetyhteyden - sujuvan suomen kielen taidon ja ammattimaisen otteen asiakasviestintään - Y-tunnuksen tai valmiuden hankkia se ennen yhteistyön alkua **Hae Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijaksi**Haluatko ottaa vastuun koko rahoitushankkeesta ja rakentaa omaa liiketoimintaasi uuden työympäristön tuella? Kerro hakemuksessa taustastasi ja vahvuuksistasi sekä siitä, miksi yritysasiakkaiden auttaminen kiinnostaa sinua.Tutustu rekrytointiprosessiin ja lähetä hakemuksesi.Suora linkki hakemukseen: https://www.financialservicesgroup.fi/rekry/haku**Käsittelemme hakemuksia jatkuvasti ja etenemme sopivien hakijoiden kanssa nopeasti.**

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.

Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt. Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: POST-DOC SOIL HEALTH AND REMEDIATION (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description: SD-26155- POST-DOC SOIL HEALTH AND REMEDIATIONFixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 MonthsAre you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defense technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute?As part of LIST's SUSTAIN unit (Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity), the Environmental Policies (EPS) group provides science-based input to the definition and implementation of environmental policies at national and EU level, in particular policies around chemical safety, soil pollution, circular (bio-)economy (e.g. construction, textile, water), and climate - and feeds, at the interface of science, technologies and policies, the regulatory perspective into RDI projects around these topics. As postdoc (R&T Scientist), you will further strengthen the activities around soil health and the management of contaminated sites via contributing to:• The further development (implementation-phase) of an Urban Soil Living Lab in Luxembourg (Horizon Europe project URSOILL - Innovative Solutions for Sustainable Urban Soil Restoration Through Living Labs) and participation in a working group on soil remediation and stabilization with nature-based solutions, especially phytoremediation and phytomanagement. Main tasks: literature review; design of field experiments and monitoring protocols across multiple urban sites; support and supervision of fieldwork; data analysis and interpretation; stakeholder engagement in the Living Lab; and scientific publications and project deliverables.• The establishment of a cross-border network of ‘Lighthouses' of phytomanagement for soil remediation, biodiversity and the regenerative economy in the Greater Region (Interreg project Light4Green),• Scientific and regulatory support, e.g. via bibliography and the preparation of a review article, on nature-based remediation solutions for Persistent organic pollutants (POPs) contamination (Interreg project Naturem),• The set-up of a laboratory for testing and evaluating soil remediation technologies (especially bioremediation and phytoremediation),• Support the definition, submission and implementation of research and collaborative project proposals of the group, and participate to the network of LIST's different activities around soil protection. Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!Education• You hold a Master's degree and a PhD in soil or environmental sciences/engineering, or another relevant natural science or engineering domain.• You have practical and solid experience in the design, testing, evaluation and application of nature-based soil remediation technologies, e.g. phytoremediation, bioremediation, mycoremediation.• Interdisciplinary thinking, well-developed communication skills (oral and written) and team spirit to successfully integrate into the multicultural, multilingual and multidisciplinary work environment at LIST and effectively communicate with LIST's partners,• Client orientation mindset and great sense of service are required. The candidate should be highly motivated, pro-active and open for new challenges and can work independently,• Not mandatory but considered an asset:o First experience in an RTO/academic environment, scientific/technical consulting, authorities, or industry on contaminated site management, pollution risk assessment or remediationo Knowledge of Luxembourg and the Greater RegionLanguage skills• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages, especially French, German, or Luxembourgish are a strong asset. Your LIST benefits• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchersApply onlineYour application must include:• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience• A scientific CV with contact details• List of publications (and patents, if applicable)• Contact details of 2 referencesPlease apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.Application procedure and conditionsWe kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.This position offers a gross monthly salary between €6094 and €6678, paid over 13 months (€79.222–€86.814 annually) based on full time employment. title: RESEARCH SCIENTIST IN GAME THEORY FOR MULTI-AGENT AI GOVERNANCE (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description: SD-27033 RESEARCH SCIENTIST IN GAME THEORY FOR MULTI-AGENT AI GOVERNANCEFixed term contract | Belval | 24 MonthsAre you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute? You will join the AI Readiness and Assessment (AIRA) group of LIST's Human-centered AI, Data and Software (HANDS) unit as the main researcher of AI-LIGNMENT, a 24-month project funded by the Luxembourg National Research Fund (FNR) under the CORE programme.AI is shifting from systems that answer prompts to agents that plan, decide and act, increasingly combined into multi-agent systems whose behaviour emerges from interaction rather than from any single model. This strains the human oversight, transparency and explainability that the EU AI Act requires. AI-LIGNMENT responds with a governance framework grounded in game theory: it translates regulatory and organisational requirements into a machine-readable admissible action space, interprets collective agent behaviour as trajectories in that space, detects drift towards undesirable regimes before violations occur, and recalibrates incentives, communication, agent identities and information conditions under human oversight. Working closely with the Principal Investigator, a research engineer and an academic mentor from the University of Cambridge, you will be mainly in charge of:•     Formalising alignment and explainability as system-level properties of interaction dynamics in LLM-based multi-agent systems, across collaborative, competitive and parallel-execution architectures.•     Developing a conceptual and formal model that translates regulatory, organisational and domain-specific requirements (notably the EU AI Act) into a machine-readable admissible action space, in connection with a domain-specific language.•     Formalising the observation–evaluation–recalibration governance loop with game-theoretic concepts: trajectory-based evaluation, regime stability, equilibrium selection and early detection of directional drift.•     Designing and running controlled, reproducible experiments and simulations with LLM-based agents to test the project hypotheses and validate system-level indicators.•     Contributing, together with the project's research engineer, to the research prototype: specifying and implementing the game-theoretic analysis module and the recalibration engine that adjusts incentives, communication and identity parameters.•     Validating the framework and prototype on a use case drawn from public administration, through baseline and recalibration experiments, and analysing their effects on system trajectories, compliance and robustness.•     Publishing your results in leading journals and conferences (e.g. IJCAI, ECAI, AIJ, JAIR, FAccT, AIES), presenting them to the research community, and contributing to the open-source release of the framework with its data and reproducibility artefacts.•     Contributing to project deliverables and reports, exchanging with regulatory authorities and public and private partners, supporting PhD students and trainees working on related topics, and helping to identify and prepare new funding opportunities. Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? title: Executive Director/Directeur Général (m/f)
description: Description des tâches:Executive Director / Directeur Général (m/f/x)Friendship Luxembourg asbl LuxembourgAbout Friendship LuxembourgFounded in 2006, Friendship Luxembourg is part of the international Friendship network and supports the work of Friendship in Bangladesh, where the organisation works with some of the country's most remote and vulnerable communities.Friendship delivers programmes across healthcare, education, economic development, humanitarian assistance and climate resilience, and is an internationally recognised, award- winning organisation, most recently named the 2025 Earthshot Prize winner in the “Fix Our Climate” category.As Friendship Luxembourg continues to grow and evolve, we are looking for an Executive Director to lead its Luxembourg operations and support the organisation's continued development.The RoleReporting to the Board of Directors and working closely with the Chair and other Board members, the Executive Director will have overall responsibility for the day-to-day management of Friendship Luxembourg and its team of six persons.This is a broad, hands-on leadership role combining operational management, team leadership, stakeholder engagement, fundraising and organisational development. The successful candidate will play a central role in ensuring that Friendship Luxembourg operates effectively, develops strong relationships with its partners and donors, and continues to strengthen its contribution to the wider Friendship network.Key Responsibilities• Lead and support the Friendship Luxembourg team, setting clear priorities and fostering an effective and collaborative working environment.• Manage the organisation's activities and continued development, ensuring effective implementation of Board decisions and agreed priorities.• Strengthen fundraising and donor engagement, while identifying new funding sources and partnership opportunities.• Oversee financial and organisational management, including budgeting, financial monitoring, resource planning and internal processes.• Work closely with the Board of Directors, providing clear reporting, ensuring effective information flow and supporting implementation of Board decisions.• Develop and maintain key external relationships with public authorities, institutional partners, foundations, NGOs, donors and other stakeholders.• Coordinate with Friendship Bangladesh and the wider Friendship network, supporting effective collaboration across the organisation.• Represent Friendship Luxembourg externally, contributing to its visibility, credibility and presence within Luxembourg's development and humanitarian ecosystem.Candidate ProfileWe are looking for an experienced and credible leader who combines sound judgement, strong interpersonal skills and a pragmatic, hands-on approach.The ideal candidate will bring:• Relevant senior management or leadership experience, gained within an NGO, foundation, international organisation or the private sector.• Proven people-management skills and experience leading a professional team.• Experience in fundraising, donor relations, stakeholder management and/or partnership development.• Strong financial, organisational and project-management capabilities.• The ability to work effectively with a Board of Directors and senior external stakeholders.• A good understanding of the Luxembourg institutional and non-profit environment.• Excellent communication, relationship-building and organisational skills.• A high degree of integrity, autonomy, judgement and commitment to Friendship's mission.• Fluency in English and French is essential. Luxembourgish would be an advantage.Other languages would also be valuable.• You must already have the legal right to work in Luxembourg and you must be able to maintain a regular on-site presence in Luxembourg.What We OfferThis is an opportunity to take on a highly visible and varied leadership role within a committed, international and mission-driven organisation.The General Manager will have the opportunity to contribute directly to the future development of Friendship Luxembourg — strengthening the organisation, developing its funding and partnerships, supporting its team and helping increase the impact of Friendship's work with vulnerable communities.Location: LuxembourgPosition: Full-timeReporting to: Board of DirectorsApplication ProcedurePlease submit your application to Friendship using the following email address only: jobs@friendship.lu. Applications to any other email address will not be considered. Your application must include your CV and a separate motivation letter. Applications may be submitted in French or English.Please note that AI-assisted tools may be used to support the analysis of your application.Deadline for submission is 4 December 2026, but early application is encouraged. You can expect to be contacted by 22 December 2026. First interviews are expected to take place during the second half of December and early January. We hope to be able to reply to all applications, however if you have not received a response from us by 23 December 2026, you may consider that your application does not meet the required criteria for this position.Études: Master (Bac+5)Métier / domaine de formation:Expérience dans une ONG ou fondation et une bonne compréhension de l'environnement institutionnel et des ONG au Luxembourg. Expérience requise: 10 années

title: HEAD OF IT OPERATIONS (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description: FA-26033 HEAD OF IT OPERATIONS & SERVICE DELIVERY Permanent contract | BelvauxAre you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join usThe Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ ContextAt LIST, IT Operations & Service Delivery is far more than a support function - it is the operational backbone that enables 840 researchers, engineers, and administrative professionals to perform at the forefront of science and technology. The Head of IT Service Delivery & Operations holds a strategic management position within the IT function, accountable for the quality, operational security, and resilience of all IT services delivered to the organisation. This role shapes how IT services are experienced across LIST - from the first contact a user has with the Service Desk to the operational security and compliance posture of the organisation's endpoints and systems. The position sits at the intersection of service excellence, operational risk, and digital workplace strategy, and plays an integral role in the IT management team alongside the Heads of IT Infrastructure, Applications, and Information Security. Moreover, it is expected from the selected candidate to play an integral strategic advisory role within the IT Service Management team and Head. And directly supports critical IT transversal projects. In a research-oriented environment where IT users range from computational scientists to environmental engineers and corporate functions, the ability to translate diverse and complex needs into reliable, well-governed IT services is a genuine strategic differentiator. This role is expected to build the operational foundations that support LIST's ambitions - today and as the organisation grows. He's in charge of 4 Offices, including the IT operations one. In total, around 40+ people (IT Service).Description - You will be mainly responsible for:IT Operations Management & Governance• Define and lead the IT Operations strategy, shaping LIST's operational IT model in alignment with the overall IT strategy and the organisation's research and innovation ambitions.• Establish and own the IT Operations governance framework - including operating model design, role clarity, accountability structures, escalation structures, and cross-domain coordination with Infrastructure, applications, and Information Security.• Act as a full member of the IT management team: contribute to strategic planning, organisational risk management, investment prioritisation, and the long-term evolution of IT services at LIST.• Develop and grow a team of 10 professionals across Service Desk, Operational Security, and Software Asset Management - building capability, fostering a culture of service excellence, and enabling career growth.• Represent IT Operations in internal governance bodies, senior stakeholder discussions, and, where relevant, external engagements (audits, vendor negotiations, regulatory interactions).Service Management, End User Computing & User experience• Define and own the digital workplace strategy for LIST's 850-person organisation - covering device lifecycle, workplace services, operating environment standardisation, and support for hybrid and remote working models.• Shape users experience with ITSM as a strategic product: set service standards, promote user satisfaction, and ensure IT is perceived as a reliable, responsive, and enabling partner across research and administrative functions.• Own Service Desk performance as a reflection of IT's reputation - building a support culture that balances efficiency with genuine user-centricity in one of the most technically diverse user communities in Luxembourg.• Coordinate communication strategy for IT operational changes, incidents, and service evolutions - ensuring that end users, managers, and senior stakeholders are informed, prepared, and engaged.Incident, Request & Operational Control• Coordinate incident and request management, ensuring effective prioritisation, timely resolution, and transparent stakeholder communication • Own and coordinate major incident management, including stakeholder communication, root cause analysis, and tracking of corrective actionsIT Security Operations & Patching• Co-own LIST's operational risk posture alongside and in smooth collaboration with the Head of Information Security and Head of IT Infrastructure - ensuring that security is embedded in day-to-day operations, not treated as an external constraint.• Oversee the IT Security Operations function, ensuring operational execution of security controls: endpoint protection, identity and access management operations, vulnerability remediation, and incident response.• Own the organisation's patching and vulnerability management cycle — establishing a risk-based, structured approach to remediation across servers, endpoints, and core systems.• Contribute to LIST's compliance and audit readiness from an operational perspective, ensuring that IT Operations can demonstrate control effectiveness to internal and external stakeholders.Asset, License & Vendor Management• Own IT asset and configuration management, ensuring CMDB accuracy and lifecycle management • Oversee software license management, ensuring compliance, cost optimisation, and vendor accountability • Manage operational vendor relationships and service providers, ensuring performance against SLAs and contractual commitments • Support budgeting, forecasting, and cost control related to IT operational services Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement• Define, monitor, and report on service performance using KPIs, SLAs, operational metrics, and user satisfaction indicators • Review trends, recurring incidents, and systemic issues, coordinating structured continuous service improvement initiatives • Promote standardisation, reliability, and operational excellence across IT servicesIs Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!Background & experience• Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.• Relevant certifications (ITIL, Microsoft, cloud) is a plus.• Extensive experience (10+ years) in IT Operations management, including hands-on experience in system management.• Demonstrated ability to define and execute an IT Operations strategy aligned with organisational goals - not just to manage existing processes.• Experience contributing to senior IT leadership discussions: investment prioritisation, risk governance, and long-term service planning.• Track record of driving organisational change through IT - whether through service model redesign, tooling transformation, or cultural shifts in how IT is consumed and valued.• Proven experience managing Service Desk, End User Computing, and operational IT teams• Demonstrated experience implementing and running ITSM processes and tools • Practical exposure to IT security operations, system patching, and v [...]

title: Gestionnaire immobilier polyvalent (H/F)
description: Qui sommes-nous ?KWARTIER est une société luxembourgeoise spécialisée dans l'investissement, la gestion et le développement immobilier. Nous accompagnons principalement des investisseurs privés et des structures patrimoniales dans la constitution, la gestion, l'optimisation et la valorisation de leur patrimoine immobilier au Luxembourg. Notre philosophie est simple : nous gérons les biens de nos clients comme s'il s'agissait de nos propres biens. Cela implique une attention particulier/ière à la préservation de leur valeur, à l'optimisation de leur rendement, à la maîtrise des coûts et à la qualité de leur entretien sur le long terme. Notre approche repose sur un accompagnement personnalisé, une grande disponibilité, une discrétion absolue et une relation de confiance avec nos clients. Nous ne nous limitons pas à la gestion quotidien/ienne des propriétés : nous cherchons également à anticiper les besoins, identifier les possibilités d'amélioration et conseiller nos clients dans leurs décisions patrimoniales. Nos activités s'articulent autour de trois pôles complémentaires :-   La gestion immobilier/ière et l'optimisation de portefeuilles : gestion administrative, technique et locative de biens immobiliers appartenant à différents propriétaires, avec une attention particulier/ière portée à leur rentabilité, leur entretien et leur valorisation. -   La promotion immobilier/ière : identification d'opportunités d'investissement, développement et réalisation de projets immobiliers, notamment résidentiels. -   La construction et la rénovation : à travers notre société AMAK Construction S.à r.l., nous réalisons et coordonnons des projets de construction, de transformation et de rénovation immobilier/ière.Cette complémentarité nous permet d'intervenir à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie d'un bien immobilier, de son acquisition à sa gestion, son développement et son éventuelle revente. Le posteDans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons un(e) gestionnaire immobilier polyvalent(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe basée à Luxembourg-Ville. Le poste sera principalement consacré à la gestion et à l'optimisation des portefeuilles de nos clients, en assurant un service de qualité à nos propriétaires et locataires. Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons actuellement un Corporate Governance Officer (H/F). Description du poste Ce poste vise à garantir une gouvernance efficace, la coordination et la documentation de tous les comités établis dans le cadre des réglementations AIFMD et OPCVM (UCITS). Il soutient l'Organe de Direction en veillant à ce que les comités fonctionnent avec des mandats clairs, des processus cohérents et des décisions dûment documentées.Le poste est centré sur la gouvernance et n'exerce pas de fonction de contrôle de conformité (compliance) ni de gestion des risques. Principales missions 1. Cadre de gouvernance des comitésLe/La Responsable Gouvernance maintient le cadre de gouvernance des comités, notamment :L'inventaire de tous les comités ;Le suivi des chartes et mandats approuvés (Terms of Reference) ;Le calendrier des revues périodiques.Il/Elle veille à ce que les mandats, responsabilités et circuits d'escalade soient documentés et appliqués de manier/ière cohérente dans toute l'organisation, conformément aux exigences réglementaires et aux standards internes de gouvernance. 2. Gestion de la composition des comitésLe poste assure :La tenue à jour du registre des membres ;Le suivi des rôles, mandats et durées de fonction ;La coordination des nominations, démissions et remplacements.Le/La titulaire veille à l'obtention des validations nécessaires et à la mise à jour de la documentation de gouvernance et des registres internes. Il/Elle collabore également avec l'équipe Compliance pour l'application pratique des procédures relatives aux conflits d'intérêts. 3. Organigramme de gouvernance et des comitésLe poste est responsable de la mise à jour de la partie « gouvernance et comités » de l'organigramme de l'entreprise, comprenant :Les structures des comités ;Les présidents des comités ;Les membres ;Les lignes de reporting vers les Ressources Humaines et les Conducting Officers.L'organigramme doit refléter fidèlement les dispositifs de gouvernance en vigueur et pouvoir être utilisé lors d'audits, d'inspections réglementaires ou de demandes de due diligence. 4. Organisation des réunions et documentationLe/La Responsable Gouvernance gère l'intégralité du cycle de vie des réunions de comité :Élaboration du calendrier annuel ;Organisation et planification des réunions ;Vérification du quorum ;Préparation des ordres du jour conformément aux mandats ;Diffusion des dossiers de réunion dans les délais impartis. Il/Elle rédige des procès-verbaux clairs et précis reflétant :Les discussions essentielles ;Les questionnements et analyses ;Les décisions prises ;Les actions à entreprendre.Il/Elle coordonne également leur revue, leur approbation et leur archivage sécurisé, ainsi que celui des documents associés. 5. Suivi des actions et tenue des registresLe poste :Assure le suivi des plans d'actions des comités ;Veille à leur attribution et à leur clôture ;Escalade les sujets lorsque nécessaire. Il/Elle maintient également un référentiel complet et structuré de la documentation de gouvernance :Chartes et mandats ;Ordres du jour ;Dossiers de réunion ;Procès-verbaux ;Décisions ;Registres des actions. Cette documentation doit pouvoir être produite rapidement en cas d'audit, de revue interne ou d'inspection réglementaire. Bien que ce poste ne relève ni de la conformité ni du risque, il requiert une bonne compréhension pratique des exigences de gouvernance liées aux réglementations AIFMD et UCITS,...

title: Risk Officer – UCITS (m/f)
description: Risk Officer – UCITS (m/f) Fundsight is looking for a Risk Officer to join its UCITS Risk Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the risk management framework for a portfolio of UCITS clients. Your role • Assist the UCITS Risk Management team with the implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework. • Prepare periodic risk reports on a daily, weekly and monthly basis. • Perform risk assessments for existing and new UCITS, determine their risk profiles and monitor applicable risk limits, including market risk (commitment and VaR), credit risk, liquidity risk, counterparty risk and operational risk indicators (including TER, PTR and NAV errors). • Contribute to the integration and monitoring of sustainability risks, including ESG, SFDR and EU Taxonomy considerations, within the risk management process. • Support the Head of Risk Management on a range of risk management matters. • Review the existing risk management framework against regulatory and internal requirements, in close cooperation with other departments. • Monitor UCITS liquidity and analyse the results of liquidity stress tests. • Provide regular updates to the Head of Risk Management and the relevant governing bodies. Your skills and experience • Master's degree in economics, finance, mathematics or a related field. • At least 2 years of previous experience in risk management, control and/or audit functions. • Good knowledge and understanding of the Luxembourg investment fund industry and the UCITS regulatory framework. • Ability to work independently, take initiative and manage priorities effectively. • Fluency in English; proficiency in French or Italian would be an asset. Who we are FundSight is an independent third-party Management Company (ManCo) based in Luxembourg, regulated by the CSSF and holding a dual AIFM and UCITS license as well as a MiFID authorization. Its business has been licensed since 1971 and was carved out and wholly acquired (100%) by BlackFin in 2025; FundSight has since been an independent company, with no operational or capital ties to Lemanik. It has a center of excellence in Porto, a branch in Paris, and representative offices in Hong Kong and Tokyo. The Group is also established in New York and Atlanta. FundSight today supports more than 120 institutional clients and manages more than €40 billion in assets under management. For more information: www.fundsight.com. How to apply If you are interested in this opportunity and would like to develop your career in a young, dynamic and international environment, please send your cover letter and detailed CV in English to recruitment@fundsight.com (reference: “Risk Officer – UCITS”). All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence. Before the employment agreement is signed, a copy of an official criminal record certificate (Bulletin No. 3), issued within the previous two months, must be provided for review.

employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description: SD-27033 RESEARCH SCIENTIST IN GAME THEORY FOR MULTI-AGENT AI GOVERNANCEFixed term contract | Belval | 24 MonthsAre you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute? You will join the AI Readiness and Assessment (AIRA) group of LIST's Human-centered AI, Data and Software (HANDS) unit as the main researcher of AI-LIGNMENT, a 24-month project funded by the Luxembourg National Research Fund (FNR) under the CORE programme.AI is shifting from systems that answer prompts to agents that plan, decide and act, increasingly combined into multi-agent systems whose behaviour emerges from interaction rather than from any single model. This strains the human oversight, transparency and explainability that the EU AI Act requires. AI-LIGNMENT responds with a governance framework grounded in game theory: it translates regulatory and organisational requirements into a machine-readable admissible action space, interprets collective agent behaviour as trajectories in that space, detects drift towards undesirable regimes before violations occur, and recalibrates incentives, communication, agent identities and information conditions under human oversight. Working closely with the Principal Investigator, a research engineer and an academic mentor from the University of Cambridge, you will be mainly in charge of:•     Formalising alignment and explainability as system-level properties of interaction dynamics in LLM-based multi-agent systems, across collaborative, competitive and parallel-execution architectures.•     Developing a conceptual and formal model that translates regulatory, organisational and domain-specific requirements (notably the EU AI Act) into a machine-readable admissible action space, in connection with a domain-specific language.•     Formalising the observation–evaluation–recalibration governance loop with game-theoretic concepts: trajectory-based evaluation, regime stability, equilibrium selection and early detection of directional drift.•     Designing and running controlled, reproducible experiments and simulations with LLM-based agents to test the project hypotheses and validate system-level indicators.•     Contributing, together with the project's research engineer, to the research prototype: specifying and implementing the game-theoretic analysis module and the recalibration engine that adjusts incentives, communication and identity parameters.•     Validating the framework and prototype on a use case drawn from public administration, through baseline and recalibration experiments, and analysing their effects on system trajectories, compliance and robustness.•     Publishing your results in leading journals and conferences (e.g. IJCAI, ECAI, AIJ, JAIR, FAccT, AIES), presenting them to the research community, and contributing to the open-source release of the framework with its data and reproducibility artefacts.•     Contributing to project deliverables and reports, exchanging with regulatory authorities and public and private partners, supporting PhD students and trainees working on related topics, and helping to identify and prepare new funding opportunities. Identifier les besoins de développement des collaborateurs et accompagner les évolutions professionnelles, en tenant compte des besoins de l'organisation. • Formation et développement : Identifier les besoins individuels et organisationnels, préparer le plan annuel de développement, sélectionner les formations pertinentes et suivre la participation, les budgets et les effets obtenus. • Relations de travail, culture et bien-être : Être le premier interlocuteur de confiance et confidentiel des salariés et des responsables ; traiter équitablement les questions courantes, soutenir le climat de travail, les relations professionnelles et la qualité de vie au travail et transmettre, selon les besoins, les situations sensibles ou à risque à la Direction ou aux conseils externes. • Politiques, processus et reporting RH : Préparer et tenir à jour des politiques, procédures, modèles, tableaux de bord et indicateurs d'effectifs clairs ; fournir à la Direction des informations RH fiables, améliorer les outils RH et coordonner, lorsque nécessaire, les prestataires juridiques, de santé au travail et autres experts externes. description: (Bijbaan) fitness/receptie - Oosterhout fitnessmedewerker  Word jij onze nieuwe fitness- en receptiemedewerker? Voor onze luxe health club in Oosterhout zijn we op zoek naar een fitness- en receptiemedewerker voor ca. 12-16 uur per week die onze leden weet te begeleiden en enthousiasmeren. Het gaat om de maandag- en dinsdagavond en vrijdagmiddag/avond. De functie van fitness- en receptiemedewerker bestaat uit diverse taken en biedt veel afwisseling. title: Investors
description: English  - Industry - Megatrends - Our Company  What are you looking for?  PCR vs Certification: Navigating Amazon's New Non‑GMO Requirements for Dietary Supplements  October 23, 2026 Amazon now requires all non-GMO claims for dietary supplements to be substantiated. Acceptable supporting evidence may include a polymerase chain reaction (PCR) test or certification issued under an Amazon-recognized third-party program such as IGEN™. Without valid substantiation, brands risk having 'non-GMO' claims removed, product listings suppressed or products removed from sale. For brands selling dietary supplements on Amazon, it is therefore important to identify an efficient way to meet these requirements while minimizing delays and administrative burdens. PCR or certification? While Amazon accepts both seller-supplied PCR testing and third-party certification as valid evidence of non-GMO claim substantiation, these two options offer very different operational and commercial outcomes for brands. PCR testing provides point-in-time verification and places ongoing responsibility on the brand, including managing documents, maintaining records and ensuring substantiation remains current as products, suppliers and formulations evolve. As a result, PCR testing typically serves as standalone evidence of non-GMO status, without delivering additional program or marketing benefits. Certification programs, by contrast, provide a more comprehensive, structured framework that supports substantiation requirements while offering ongoing oversight, consumer-facing recognition, and broader marketing value beyond Amazon compliance. Depending on the program, certification may also streamline enrollment and create recognizable trust signals that strengthen consumer confidence and brand positioning. Why choose IGEN Launched in 2016, the International Genetically Modified Organism (GMO) Evaluation and Notification Program (IGEN) offers a streamlined, efficient...
