title: Senior Programme Finance Officer
description: Ref 2592948 \| Date: 25 Nov 2026![Michael Page]( )We are recruiting for our client a Senior Programme Finance Officer for an initial 6\-month contract.The Senior Programme Finance Officer will play a key role in supporting the financial management and administration of assigned programme and project portfolios.  Senior Programme Finance OfficerOur client is an organisation operating in the not\-for\-profit sector.**Description**Under the direct supervision of the Senior Manager, the Senior Programme Finance Officer will undertake the following responsibilities:1\. Programme Financial Management* Serve as the finance focal point for designated programme portfolios, providing proactive financial guidance and support to programme managers and technical teams* Support the preparation, consolidation, review, and monitoring of programme budgets, annual work plans, forecasts, and financial projections* Monitor expenditure trends, commitments, and budget utilisation, analysing variances and identifying financial risks opportunities, and corrective actions* Support programme resource planning and cost recovery management, ensuring the appropriate allocation and recovery of direct and indirect costs* Prepare financial analyses, dashboards, and management reports that support programme performance monitoring and informed decision\-making* Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and completeness of financial data across corporate systems and reporting platforms* Promote compliance with organisational financial procedures, time recording requirements, cost allocation methodologies, and internal control standards* Identify and escalate financial risks, compliance concerns, and operational issues in a timely manner2\. Project Financial Management and Donor Compliance* Support project managers throughout the project lifecycle, including proposal development, budget preparation, implementation, reporting, audit coordination, and project closure* Review project budgets and financial plans to ensure alignment with donor regulations, contractual requirements, and internal policies and procedures* Support the financial management of projects funded by institutional donors, including the European Union, bilateral and multilateral agencies, government institutions, foundations, and private sector partners* Prepare, review, and validate donor financial reports, ensuring accuracy, completeness, audit readiness, and timely submission* Monitor contractual financial obligations, reporting schedules, co\-financing commitments, and budget utilisation across assigned projects* Coordinate project audits and financial verifications, including the preparation of supporting documentation, audit schedules, management responses, and follow\-up actions* Ensure compliance with donor agreements, grant conditions, and organisational financial policies* Support financial oversight of implementing partners and subcontractors, including budget reviews, financial reporting, and compliance assessments* Collaborate closely with regional finance teams and programme staff to ensure consistency and quality in project financial management practices3\. Contract Management, Procurement, and Internal Compliance* Support the financial review of contracts, grant agreements, consultancy agreements, and procurement processes* Verify the adequacy of project budgets, funding availability, and financial provisions before submission for internal approval* Coordinate with Legal, Procurement, Finance, and Programme teams to facilitate efficient contract and procurement workflows* Ensure adherence to internal policies, internal controls, delegated authorities, and donor\-specific procurement requirements* Maintain comprehensive and audit\-ready financial and contractual records in accordance with organisational standards and record\-management requirements.4\. Financial Systems, Reporting, and Process Improvement* Maintain reliable financial data and reporting systems, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and effective monitoring* Develop and improve financial tools, dashboards, and processes to enhance efficiency, transparency, and data quality* Support users and system deployments, including training, testing, and the implementation of new financial and operational solutions5\. Coordination, Capacity Building, and Business Partnering* Foster strong working relationships with programme teams, regional offices, implementing partners, and corporate service functions* Provide day\-to\-day financial advice and guidance to project managers and technical staff* Support capacity\-building initiatives by delivering training, coaching, and knowledge\-sharing activities on financial management, donor compliance, and internal procedures**Profile**The successful Senior Programme Finance Officer should have:* Advanced University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field* A recognised professional accounting qualification ( ACCA, CPA, CIMA, CA or equivalent) is required* At least eight years of progressively responsible professional experience in finance, grants management, project finance, or programme financial management in an international organisation, NGO, development agency, or similar environment* Demonstrated experience managing donor\-funded projects and grants, including budget development, financial monitoring, donor reporting, and audit coordination* Strong knowledge of institutional donor requirements, particularly those of the European Union and major bilateral and multilateral donors* Experience supporting complex, multi\-country or multi\-partner programmes is highly desirable* Experience coordinating financial audits and responding to audit findings* Proven experience in financial analysis, forecasting, budgeting, and management reporting* Experience contributing to process improvement, financial systems implementation, or business transformation initiatives is an asset* Experience in auditing donor funded projects an added advantage* Excellent command of written and spoken English is required* Working knowledge of French and/or Spanish would be a distinct advantage* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications* Experience using ERP systems and financial management platforms* Strong capability in financial reporting, data analysis, and the use of financial management tools and databases* Experience with project management and grant management systems is desirable**Job Offer**Join a well\-established organisation for a 6\-month assignment.jpidf84662djm jpit1148jm jpiy26jm

title: Fundraising Delegate Mittel- und Südamerika
description: Finanzielle Nachhaltigkeit ist ein zentrales Anliegen der Rotkreuz\- und Rothalbmondgesellschaften (RKRH). Die nationalen Rotkreuz\-Gesellschaften in Mittel\- und Südamerika sind oft auf internationale Fördermittel und Einnahmen aus Vermögenswerten und Dienstleistungen angewiesen. Die meisten von ihnen setzen die Mittelbeschaffung durch lokale private Geldgeber noch nicht systematisch ein. Ab 2027 unterstützt die Abteilung Internationales des Schweizerischen Roten Kreuzes (SRK) mehrere Partnergesellschaften in Mittel\- und Südamerika dabei, diese Form der Mittelbeschaffung aufzubauen. description: Vorsorgeexperte/in Oberland Vorsorgeexperte/in Oberland===========================Hallo  Teamspirit.  Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und ihre Bedürfnisse. Und du bringst wertvolle Erfahrungen in der Vorsorgeberatung mit und hast einen gesunden Ehrgeiz. Nutze die einmalige Chance und wirke von Anfang an in unserem neuen Geschäftsbereich «Leben» mit. Du fokussierst dich auf die proaktive Beratung unserer Kundinnen und Kunden für unsere Vorsorgeprodukte. Die Kundenberaterinnen und \-berater der Generalagentur unterstützen dich dabei mit Leads aus unserer breiten Kundenbasis. Von uns kommen ein erstklassiges Anstellungspaket, eine top interne Aus\- und Weiterbildung und die Flexibilität, damit du Beruf und Privates gut auf die Reihe bringst. Lass uns über eine gemeinsame Zukunft sprechen.Vorsorgeexperte/in Oberland===========================**So sieht dein Alltag aus*** Du bearbeitest die Leads deiner Generalagentur und als Coach unterstützt du die Berater in ihrer fachlichen und verkäuferischen Entwicklung.* Du pflegst bestehende Beziehungen und gewinnst aktiv neue Kundinnen und Kunden für die private Vorsorge.* Vorsorgeberatungen führst du persönlich oder remote durch und entwickelst individuelle Lösungen, die du erfolgreich verkaufst.* Du stärkst die Bindung zu Bestandskunden, erkennst Verkaufschancen und arbeitest eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen, um diese Cross\- und Upselling\-Potenziale zu nutzen.* Für wertvolle Kundeninteraktionen nutzt du moderne Tools und repräsentierst uns mit passenden Marketing\- und Vertriebsmassnahmen.* Auch die Anliegen und Fragen unserer Kundinnen und Kunden beantwortest du partnerschaftlich und mit viel Empathie.**Das bringst du mit*** Das Wichtigste zuerst: Du hast eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung und hast die VBV\-Zertifizierung erfolgreich erhalten. Verfügst du zudem über eine weiterführende Ausbildung wie bspw. als dipl. Finanzberater/in IAF? Umso besser!* Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in der Vorsorgeberatung mit und verfolgst deine Verkaufsziele mit viel Leidenschaft.* Man merkt, dass du gerne unter Menschen bist – du kannst dich gut in dein Gegenüber hineinversetzen, erkennst seine Bedürfnisse und gehst in deiner Beratung individuell darauf ein.* Du drückst dich sehr gut in Deutsch aus (mündlich und schriftlich). Vielleicht beherrschst du sogar weitere Sprachen?* Du hast ein grosses Beziehungsnetz, pflegst es nachhaltig und wohnst vorzugsweise in der Region.* Für Beratungen ausserhalb der Agentur und auch mal ausserhalb der offiziellen Ansprechzeiten bist du flexibel und mobil.**Gute Argumente \- typisch CSS*** Arbeite flexibel: Passe deine Arbeit jährlich an deinen Lebensstil an \- mit Teilzeitoptionen und anderen flexiblen Modellen wie Homeoffice und weiteren mehr.* Erfreue dein Portemonnaie: Benefits wie Bonus, , vergünstigte Krankenkassenprämie und weitere, die schnell einmal ein paar Tausender im Jahr ausmachen.* Wähle dein Ferienmodell: 5 oder 6 Wochen Ferien? Deine Entscheidung. Entsprechend arbeitest du 41 oder 42 Stunden pro Woche.* Bilde dich weiter: Wir sehen es gerne, wenn du dich intern oder extern weiterbildest und unterstützen grosszügig mit Zeit und Geld.* Bleibe fit: Ergonomische Arbeitplätze, Förderung des mentalen Wohlbefindens und viele weitere Angebote rund um deine Gesundheit.* Engagiere dich sozial: Das Leben meint es gut mit dir? Dann lass andere an deinem teilhaben und erweitere alleine oder im Team deinen Horizont.**Kontakt**  Fragen zur Stelle an deine/n Führungsverantwortliche/n?  Kaurinovic ist für dich da.  Fragen zum Bewerbungsprozess?  Kisungu ist für dich da.  Diese Stelle besetzen wir ohne externe Personalagenturen.![CSS]()jid1ff2408jm jit1148jm jiy26jm

applications* Experience using ERP systems and financial management platforms* Strong capability in financial reporting, data analysis, and the use of financial management tools and databases* International Corporate Communications Project Leader
=====================================================

**The company**

Tissot has been growing and developing its tradition of innovation since 1853\. From the early days to the present, in its home in Le Locle in the Swiss Jura mountains, Tissot has translated craftsmanship and precision into stylish timepieces now sold in over 160 countries around the world. Special materials, advanced functionality and meticulous design details join forces to create the luxury of accessibility.

Today Tissot is a member of the Swatch Group, the world's largest watch producer and distributor of Swiss watches. The tradition of innovation lives on, keeping closely in touch with the times.

We are looking for a **Senior International Corporate Communications Project Leader** to join our international team based in Le Locle. The successful candidate will be part of the international PR team and report to the PR Manager.

**Job description**

In this role, you will take ownership of corporate communications, ensuring clear, consistent and impactful messaging across key audiences and channels. Working closely with senior leadership and internal stakeholders, you will support high\-profile communications opportunities and lead a range of corporate communications projects.

The role combines strong editorial skills, strategic awareness, discretion and the ability to build trusted relationships across the organisation and with external stakeholders.

**Your responsibilities**

* Own and coordinate corporate communications activities, ensuring consistency of messaging and corporate narrative.
* Support the PR Manager and senior leadership on corporate communications, media opportunities and high\-profile engagements.
* Develop and coordinate corporate communications materials and messaging across relevant channels, including digital and social media.
* Lead selected corporate communications projects from development through to execution.
* Build strong relationships with media, internal stakeholders and external partners.
* Support communications in sensitive or high\-pressure situations, ensuring clear and consistent messaging.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen corporate visibility, reputation and positioning.
* Monitor relevant media, corporate and industry developments and provide insights to inform communications.
* Contribute to the continuous development of corporate communications tools and practices.


**Profile**

* Excellent communicator with strong editorial judgement and storytelling skills
* Strategic, creative and curious, with a strong understanding of corporate reputation and communications
* Confident working with senior stakeholders and handling sensitive information with discretion
* Highly organised, proactive and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build trusted relationships across functions and markets
* Detail\-oriented, agile and solutions\-focused, with the ability to see the bigger picture
* A genuine sensitivity to brand image, corporate reputation and the luxury environment


**Professional requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
* Minimum 7 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in an international environment
* Proven experience in corporate communications, editorial content and media relations
* Experience working with senior executives and supporting high\-profile communications
* Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills
* Experience in luxury, fashion, beauty, lifestyle or premium consumer sectors is a plus
* Experience in digital and social communications is an advantage


**Languages**

* Fluent in English and French, both written and spoken, is a must
* German is an advantage
* Additional languages are a plus

title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS-SBR)---Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)============================================================================================================ Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.The Department of Process Engineering has a vacancy for aMaster thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)============================================================================================================Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in , which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. By calibrating and validating the model against real\-world datasets, the project seeks to improve the understanding of DAS\-SBR system and to provide a reliable tool for process analysis, optimization, and future design. **We are looking for** a motivated master thesis student or intern, who needs to be enrolled in a university for the entire thesis/internship duration, with interests in advanced technologies for biological wastewater treatment and modelling biological processes. Fluent spoken and written English are essential. Strong data analysis and programming skills and experience with modelling in Sumo are highly recommended. **The preferred starting date is** September/October 2026 onwards, not later than March 2027\. **At Eawag**, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it\-we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information about Eawag and its conditions of employment, please visit and . **Applications can be submitted until the position is filled** and will therefore be evaluated on a rolling basis. Applications should include a short letter (max. one page) describing your interests and their relevance to this position, a CV, and a list of lectures/transcripts of records from the university.For further information, please contact or . **We look forward to receiving your application.** Please send it through this webpage, as any other way of applying will not be considered.
